title: More Tribbles, More Troubles
line: Captain's log, stardate 5392.4. The Enterprise has been assigned to escort two robot grain ships to Sherman's Planet, which has been struck by crop failures and famine. This shipment of seed grain, quintrotriticale, is necessary to the survival of the colonists. We are breaking course to Sherman's Planet to investigate what appears to be a Klingon battle cruiser pursuing some kind of smaller ship. Observation may confirm a rumor that the Klingons have a new weapon, type so far unknown.

title: More Tribbles, More Troubles
line: Captain, it is a Klingon ship. Rapidly closing on its target.

title: More Tribbles, More Troubles
line: Sensors indicate the smaller vessel is a one-man scout ship of common design.

title: More Tribbles, More Troubles
line: They're firing on him.

title: More Tribbles, More Troubles
line: Klingon battle cruiser, identify yourself. Ahead, warp factor six. Scotty, lock the transporter on that small vessel. We're going to rescue that pilot.

title: More Tribbles, More Troubles
line: Aye, aye, Captain.

title: More Tribbles, More Troubles
line: Locking on.

title: More Tribbles, More Troubles
line: Open hailing frequencies. Klingon battle cruiser, identify yourself. You are violating Federation space. Identify yourself. Stop firing on scout ship.

title: More Tribbles, More Troubles
line: Arm all phasers. Deflector shields up.

title: More Tribbles, More Troubles
line: Phasers armed. Shields up.

title: More Tribbles, More Troubles
line: Ahead warp factor eight. Klingon battle cruiser, identify yourself.

title: More Tribbles, More Troubles
line: They got him.

title: More Tribbles, More Troubles
line: Scotty, have you got that pilot yet?

title: More Tribbles, More Troubles
line: I don't know, sir.

title: More Tribbles, More Troubles
line: That Klingon . That blast decalibrated the integration parameters.

title: More Tribbles, More Troubles
line: Captain. (The Klingon ship is coming straight for them. Red Alert sounds. A wibbly energy field is fired at Enterprise)

title: More Tribbles, More Troubles
line: The new weapon. Spock?

title: More Tribbles, More Troubles
line: Some kind of field effect, Captain. It will hit us in precisely four seconds. It produces a most remarkable disruption.

title: More Tribbles, More Troubles
line: Now, what

title: More Tribbles, More Troubles
line: Our engines are dead.

title: More Tribbles, More Troubles
line: Captain, we have been hit by a kind of projected stasis field. Our matter-antimatter generators are disabled. We are paralyzed.

title: More Tribbles, More Troubles
line: Fire phasers.

title: More Tribbles, More Troubles
line: The phasers don't work, sir.

title: More Tribbles, More Troubles
line: The photon torpedoes will not respond, either. The stasis field disables all higher-order field and warp functions.

title: More Tribbles, More Troubles
line: Well, we could always throw rocks.

title: More Tribbles, More Troubles
line: This new Klingon weapon must be one of surprising power if it can immobilize a starship. The energy drain on the Klingon ship would be enormous.

title: More Tribbles, More Troubles
line: Scotty, did you get that pilot?

title: More Tribbles, More Troubles
line: I got him in the beam, sir.

title: More Tribbles, More Troubles
line: But I can't integrate him. The system's been diskoordinated.

title: More Tribbles, More Troubles
line: Captain, I have a message coming in, sir.

title: More Tribbles, More Troubles
line: Put it on the viewscreen.

title: More Tribbles, More Troubles
line: Ah, Captain Kirk.

title: More Tribbles, More Troubles
line: Release my ship.

title: More Tribbles, More Troubles
line: I'd be delighted to, Captain Kirk, if you will turn over the pilot of the little ship.

title: More Tribbles, More Troubles
line: That ship was a Federation-built craft. The pilot is under our protection.

title: More Tribbles, More Troubles
line: He has committed ecological sabotage. If I have to take him by force, I will.

title: More Tribbles, More Troubles
line: The first Klingon to step aboard this ship will be the last Klingon. Full security alert, Mister Spock.

title: More Tribbles, More Troubles
line: I'm afraid, Captain Kirk, you'll find your phasers no longer work, nor any of your weapons.

title: More Tribbles, More Troubles
line: Mister Spock, I'm losing contact with our robot ships. They're not held by the stasis field and they're moving out of range.

title: More Tribbles, More Troubles
line: What was that? Lieutenant, cut off that frequency.

title: More Tribbles, More Troubles
line: Yes, sir. The robot ships, they're moving off.

title: More Tribbles, More Troubles
line: They still have power? We still control them?

title: More Tribbles, More Troubles
line: Affirmative, sir.

title: More Tribbles, More Troubles
line: Bring them back, Mister Sulu. Have them ram the Klingon ship.

title: More Tribbles, More Troubles
line: Captain, you can't afford to lose that grain.

title: More Tribbles, More Troubles
line: I can afford even less to lose the Enterprise. Open the hailing frequency again, Lieutenant. Captain Koloth. I'm going to give you one last chance to release the Enterprise.

title: More Tribbles, More Troubles
line: You're going to give me one chance? It won't work, Captain Kirk.

title: More Tribbles, More Troubles
line: It will work, or he'd still be gloating. Bring the robot ships in from two different angles, Mister Sulu.

title: More Tribbles, More Troubles
line: Incredible. The amount of energy that field must require.

title: More Tribbles, More Troubles
line: They couldn't maintain the stasis field.

title: More Tribbles, More Troubles
line: Keep your phasers locked on target, Mister Sulu. Hold your fire until they fire first.

title: More Tribbles, More Troubles
line: Aye, sir. Phasers locked on.

title: More Tribbles, More Troubles
line: Apparently their battle capacity is down. They only damaged it.

title: More Tribbles, More Troubles
line: They're veering off.

title: More Tribbles, More Troubles
line: Sensors indicate their power cells are almost exhausted. They probably don't have the strength for a prolonged battle now.

title: More Tribbles, More Troubles
line: Scotty, can you integrate that pilot now?

title: More Tribbles, More Troubles
line: I think so, Captain.

title: More Tribbles, More Troubles
line: We'll be right there.

title: More Tribbles, More Troubles
line: Call McCoy to the Transporter room. Spock.

title: More Tribbles, More Troubles
line: Have you got him?

title: More Tribbles, More Troubles
line: Just putting him together now, sir.

title: More Tribbles, More Troubles
line: I think we know that man.

title: More Tribbles, More Troubles
line: It appears to be

title: More Tribbles, More Troubles
line: I don't want to think about it.

title: More Tribbles, More Troubles
line: Cyrano Jones!

title: More Tribbles, More Troubles
line: And he's got tribbles with him. Tribbles!

title: More Tribbles, More Troubles
line: Captain's log, supplemental. Our rescue effort has given us some knowledge of the new Klingon weapon and the presence of Cyrano Jones, intergalactic trader and general nuisance.

title: More Tribbles, More Troubles
line: Captain Kirk. Friend Kirk.

title: More Tribbles, More Troubles
line: Seal off the area, Ensign. You know the law about transporting animals proven harmful.

title: More Tribbles, More Troubles
line: Captain, these are safe tribbles.

title: More Tribbles, More Troubles
line: There's no such thing as a safe tribble.

title: More Tribbles, More Troubles
line: A safe tribble would be a contradiction in terms. Tribbles are well known for their proclivities in multiplication.

title: More Tribbles, More Troubles
line: And they breed fast, too. And that's why these tribbles are safe. They don't reproduce.

title: More Tribbles, More Troubles
line: Don't reproduce?

title: More Tribbles, More Troubles
line: I've had them genetically engineered for compatibility with humanoid ecologies. See how friendly and loveable they are? And not a baby in the bunch. They're great pets and profitable, too.

title: More Tribbles, More Troubles
line: Jones, how did you get away from Space Station K7? You were supposed to clean up all the tribbles there.

title: More Tribbles, More Troubles
line: Oh, well, I managed a short parole. I found some help. This is a tribble predator. It's called a glommer.

title: More Tribbles, More Troubles
line: Watch.

title: More Tribbles, More Troubles
line: Well, at least it's neat.

title: More Tribbles, More Troubles
line: Why were the Klingons chasing you, Jones?

title: More Tribbles, More Troubles
line: How should I know? Klingons have notoriously bad tempers.

title: More Tribbles, More Troubles
line: That may be true, but they rarely enter Federation space and fire on Federation vessels without reason.

title: More Tribbles, More Troubles
line: They did mention ecological sabotage.

title: More Tribbles, More Troubles
line: Me? A saboteur? Ridiculous.

title: More Tribbles, More Troubles
line: Captain Koloth was pretty emphatic.

title: More Tribbles, More Troubles
line: It was such a little thing. I can't understand at all why they got upset.

title: More Tribbles, More Troubles
line: What did you do?

title: More Tribbles, More Troubles
line: I only sold them some tribbles.

title: More Tribbles, More Troubles
line: You sold tribbles on a Klingon planet?

title: More Tribbles, More Troubles
line: Well, I didn't know it was a Klingon planet.

title: More Tribbles, More Troubles
line: Tribbles don't like Klingons. That should have given you some clue.

title: More Tribbles, More Troubles
line: Klingons like tribbles even less. It was lucky you came along and saved me when you did, Friend Kirk. I couldn't have outrun them much longer.

title: More Tribbles, More Troubles
line: According to our computer files, Jones, you are in violation of three Federation mandates and forty seven local ones. You're confined until we complete our mission. Then we'll turn you over to the proper authorities.

title: More Tribbles, More Troubles
line: Captain, couldn't we talk this over? I didn't think so.

title: More Tribbles, More Troubles
line: Jim, Cyrano Jones is right. These tribbles don't reproduce. They just get fat. I don't think we have anything to worry about.

title: More Tribbles, More Troubles
line: Not about tribbles, anyway. I am concerned about that new Klingon weapon.

title: More Tribbles, More Troubles
line: It is an energy-sapping field of great strength, Captain. It immobilizes a starship and its weapons capability. But apparently, it also immobilizes the attacking ship's abilities at the same time.

title: More Tribbles, More Troubles
line: Aye, and if that's true, then it's a weapon that leaves them as helpless as it does us.

title: More Tribbles, More Troubles
line: I believe I just said that, Mister Scott.

title: More Tribbles, More Troubles
line: The practical advantages of such a weapon would seem to be limited.

title: More Tribbles, More Troubles
line: Perhaps, but there are logical applications. The key question is, how long does it take them to recharge? They will probably attack us again as soon as they are back up to power. And they will probably begin by destroying the other robot ship to prevent us from repeating the same trick. They want Cyrano Jones very badly.

title: More Tribbles, More Troubles
line: He really doesn't seem the saboteur type, Jim.

title: More Tribbles, More Troubles
line: Yes. Status report on the damaged grain ship, Scotty?

title: More Tribbles, More Troubles
line: Well, sir, we've managed to transfer all the grain aboard, but it severely limits us. We filled the shuttlecraft hangars, all our extra holds, and we've even got containers of that wheat, that quintrotriticale, in the corridors of the ship. And then we've got that other robot ship to escort, too. I don't like it at all, sir.

title: More Tribbles, More Troubles
line: Nor do I, Mister Scott, but we've got to do it. Sherman's Planet needs that grain desperately.

title: More Tribbles, More Troubles
line: Aye, sir, but we've got tribbles on the ship, quintrotriticale in the corridors, Klingons in the quadrant. It can ruin your whole day, sir.

title: More Tribbles, More Troubles
line: Captain, sensors are picking up a Klingon battle cruiser.

title: More Tribbles, More Troubles
line: Deflector shields up. Stand by phasers. How fat do these things get?

title: More Tribbles, More Troubles
line: Klingon ship approaching rapidly. Within phaser range in thirty seconds.

title: More Tribbles, More Troubles
line: Obviously, they can recharge their power in a matter of hours.

title: More Tribbles, More Troubles
line: Use the robot ship as a decoy. Have it change course and move off. We'll use it again to give the Klingons trouble. They can't control more than one ship at a time with their stasis field.

title: More Tribbles, More Troubles
line: Beginning evasive maneuvers.

title: More Tribbles, More Troubles
line: The Klingon seems to be veering off. My mistake, Captain. They were not veering off. They were attacking the grain ship.

title: More Tribbles, More Troubles
line: But they didn't destroy it. They only wrecked the propulsion units. They left the cargo intact.

title: More Tribbles, More Troubles
line: Captain Koloth is quite a marksman.

title: More Tribbles, More Troubles
line: They've changed course. They're coming in again.

title: More Tribbles, More Troubles
line: Ready phasers.

title: More Tribbles, More Troubles
line: Phasers armed and ready, sir.

title: More Tribbles, More Troubles
line: Photon torpedoes. Fire one.

title: More Tribbles, More Troubles
line: They're running away. Very odd. They did not use their stasis weapon at all.

title: More Tribbles, More Troubles
line: Perhaps they haven't had enough time to recharge it.

title: More Tribbles, More Troubles
line: Or the purpose of the attack was something else.

title: More Tribbles, More Troubles
line: They disabled the robot ship.

title: More Tribbles, More Troubles
line: Scotty, put a tractor beam on it. We'll take it in tow.

title: More Tribbles, More Troubles
line: Captain, that could be exactly what they want us to do. Tow the robot and limit our available power. We're carrying the extra mass of the first ship's cargo, and now we have the second one in tow. That requires a great deal of power we won't be able to use in battle.

title: More Tribbles, More Troubles
line: That seems logical.

title: More Tribbles, More Troubles
line: Thank you.

title: More Tribbles, More Troubles
line: Well, Mister Spock, do you have any ideas?

title: More Tribbles, More Troubles
line: We could always throw tribbles at them.

title: More Tribbles, More Troubles
line: I thought Vulcans didn't have a sense of humor.

title: More Tribbles, More Troubles
line: We don't, Captain.

title: More Tribbles, More Troubles
line: Captain, we've got broken cargo containers in all the corridors, and the tribbles are eating the grain.

title: More Tribbles, More Troubles
line: Get Cyrano Jones up here.

title: More Tribbles, More Troubles
line: Aye, sir.

title: More Tribbles, More Troubles
line: Any sign of Captain Koloth's ship?

title: More Tribbles, More Troubles
line: Nothing, sir.

title: More Tribbles, More Troubles
line: Keep scanning.

title: More Tribbles, More Troubles
line: Captain Kirk, what can I do for you? Some Spican flame gems perhaps?

title: More Tribbles, More Troubles
line: Your tribbles are all over my ship. My security men can't find them all.

title: More Tribbles, More Troubles
line: You need better security men, Captain.

title: More Tribbles, More Troubles
line: Mister Jones, you are in enough trouble already.

title: More Tribbles, More Troubles
line: Captain, a harmless little tribble. What can they hurt?

title: More Tribbles, More Troubles
line: Harmless, maybe. Little? In any case, they're eating the quintrotriticale.

title: More Tribbles, More Troubles
line: The what?

title: More Tribbles, More Troubles
line: The wheat!

title: More Tribbles, More Troubles
line: They're hungry, Captain.

title: More Tribbles, More Troubles
line: So are the people on Sherman's Planet. A little tribble doesn't eat much, a big tribble does. And these are growing. Jones, is this the ecological sabotage the Klingons are so mad about?

title: More Tribbles, More Troubles
line: Captain, the Klingons are coming back.

title: More Tribbles, More Troubles
line: Speak of the devil.

title: More Tribbles, More Troubles
line: Jim, there's something about these tribbles.

title: More Tribbles, More Troubles
line: Later, Bones. Mister Sulu, release the robot ship. We'll swing back and pick it up later. Deflector shields up. Stand by photon torpedoes. And all noncombatants off the Bridge.

title: More Tribbles, More Troubles
line: Captain's log, supplemental. The Klingon ship under command of Captain Koloth is forcing us into a battle for custody of Cyrano Jones for reasons still unknown.

title: More Tribbles, More Troubles
line: Contact in thirty seconds.

title: More Tribbles, More Troubles
line: Ready photon torpedoes. Fire one.

title: More Tribbles, More Troubles
line: One fired.

title: More Tribbles, More Troubles
line: That's done it. We're caught.

title: More Tribbles, More Troubles
line: Message coming in, sir.

title: More Tribbles, More Troubles
line: Ah, Captain Kirk. We'll take control of your ship now.

title: More Tribbles, More Troubles
line: Not if I can help it.

title: More Tribbles, More Troubles
line: I want your prisoner.

title: More Tribbles, More Troubles
line: Much as I hate to admit it, Captain Koloth, Cyrano Jones is a citizen of the Federation and entitled to Federation protection. I must, much as it pains me, refuse your request.

title: More Tribbles, More Troubles
line: It is not a request. Don't force me to take steps that we will both regret.

title: More Tribbles, More Troubles
line: Close channel, Lieutenant.

title: More Tribbles, More Troubles
line: With pleasure, sir.

title: More Tribbles, More Troubles
line: Aren't you going to sit down, sir?

title: More Tribbles, More Troubles
line: I think I'll stand.

title: More Tribbles, More Troubles
line: Implement boarding plan C.

title: More Tribbles, More Troubles
line: Yes, sir.

title: More Tribbles, More Troubles
line: Mister Scott, we're going to implement Emergency defense plan B.

title: More Tribbles, More Troubles
line: Plan B, sir?

title: More Tribbles, More Troubles
line: Mister Spock suggested it.

title: More Tribbles, More Troubles
line: Emergency plan B complete, sir.

title: More Tribbles, More Troubles
line: Open hailing frequencies, Lieutenant. Captain Koloth, are you ready to release my ship?

title: More Tribbles, More Troubles
line: Release your ship? Kirk, you are monotonous.

title: More Tribbles, More Troubles
line: You don't know yet, do you?

title: More Tribbles, More Troubles
line: Know what?

title: More Tribbles, More Troubles
line: That we have immobilized your ship worse than you have immobilized ours.

title: More Tribbles, More Troubles
line: I doubt that. Our instruments report nothing except some undue transporter activity and Kirk? Tribbles?

title: More Tribbles, More Troubles
line: Tribbles.

title: More Tribbles, More Troubles
line: Kirk, Cyrano Jones took a Klingon genetic construct, an artificial creature from one of our planets. We must have it back. It was designed to be a tribble predator. We are prepared to go to war if we have to.

title: More Tribbles, More Troubles
line: You must have others.

title: More Tribbles, More Troubles
line: This was the first one, Kirk. We need it in order to grow others from it. We need it to get rid of the tribbles

title: More Tribbles, More Troubles
line: Jones sold before they completely overrun the planet.

title: More Tribbles, More Troubles
line: And that's all you want?

title: More Tribbles, More Troubles
line: Jones is not that important.

title: More Tribbles, More Troubles
line: We must have the glommer.

title: More Tribbles, More Troubles
line: Oh, well, if that's all. Mister Scott, transport the glommer over to the Klingon ship.

title: More Tribbles, More Troubles
line: Aye, sir.

title: More Tribbles, More Troubles
line: You can't do this to me. Under space salvage laws, he's mine.

title: More Tribbles, More Troubles
line: A planetary surface is not covered by space salvage laws. But if you want the little beastie that bad, Mister Jones, we'll transport you over with it.

title: More Tribbles, More Troubles
line: I withdraw my claim.

title: More Tribbles, More Troubles
line: Well, at least we can report the stasis field is not as effective a weapon as we thought. The power drain is too high and takes too long for the Klingon ship to recover to make it practical.

title: More Tribbles, More Troubles
line: Agreed, Captain. Tribbles appear to be a much more effective weapon.

title: More Tribbles, More Troubles
line: Jones' genetic engineering was very slipshod. Jim. He may have kept the tribbles from reproducing, but he didn't slow down their metabolism. You see, they're not just giant tribbles, they're colonies.

title: More Tribbles, More Troubles
line: Captain, the engine room is filled with tribble.

title: More Tribbles, More Troubles
line: Well, we can do something about that. Attack.

title: More Tribbles, More Troubles
line: He did it to us again! That tin-plated, overbearing excuse for a starship captain did it to us again. Blast that thing.

title: More Tribbles, More Troubles
line: Any other orders, sir?

title: More Tribbles, More Troubles
line: Yes. Don't do that again. Ever.

title: More Tribbles, More Troubles
line: A simple shot of neoethylene will fix everything. The tribble colonies will break down into their individual units with a slower metabolic rate. And these really will be safe tribbles now.

title: More Tribbles, More Troubles
line: Er, what about the Klingons?

title: More Tribbles, More Troubles
line: Well, unless they treat their tribbles too, that ship isn't going to be big enough for all of them.

title: More Tribbles, More Troubles
line: Say, you didn't get this one, Bones.

title: More Tribbles, More Troubles
line: Oh yes I did.

title: More Tribbles, More Troubles
line: But it hasn't Someday I'll learn.

title: More Tribbles, More Troubles
line: Aye, Captain. But you've got to admit, if we've got to have tribbles, it's best if all our tribbles are little ones.

title: The Infinite Vulcan
line: Captain's log, stardate 5554.4. The Enterprise has been ordered to survey a new planet recently diskovered at the periphery of the galaxy.

title: The Infinite Vulcan
line: Life readings are confused, sir. I can't decipher them.

title: The Infinite Vulcan
line: There is something else, Captain. I'm getting a reading of some kind of power from that building)

title: The Infinite Vulcan
line: Well, now. What's this? Captain! Captain!

title: The Infinite Vulcan
line: What is it, Mister Sulu?

title: The Infinite Vulcan
line: You're going to have to see this yourself, sir.

title: The Infinite Vulcan
line: What is that thing?

title: The Infinite Vulcan
line: It's a mobile plant. When it stops, it's roots bore back into the ground. They're all over the place. I think it likes me.

title: The Infinite Vulcan
line: We always encourage our officers to make friends with the natives.

title: The Infinite Vulcan
line: Captain, the power reading now includes an electronic probe. We are being scanned.

title: The Infinite Vulcan
line: Phasers on stun. Stay alert. Mister Sulu, stay here.

title: The Infinite Vulcan
line: Ow! Must have been a thorn.

title: The Infinite Vulcan
line: The probe originates in this wall, as does an incredibly powerful force shield. It appears to be an amalgam of devices designed to defend and protect the city and this building in particular.

title: The Infinite Vulcan
line: Jim, I'm picking up a humanoid reading of incredible strength. It's as if he

title: The Infinite Vulcan
line: Argh!

title: The Infinite Vulcan
line: He's been poisoned. Unknown toxin.

title: The Infinite Vulcan
line: Can you help him?

title: The Infinite Vulcan
line: I can't get a correlation with any known poison.

title: The Infinite Vulcan
line: Maybe the ship's medical computers.

title: The Infinite Vulcan
line: He's got about one minute to live unless I can find an answer. Maybe dylovene. No good. Takes too much time to work if it does work.

title: The Infinite Vulcan
line: Maybe a stronger shot.

title: The Infinite Vulcan
line: That won't be necessary.

title: The Infinite Vulcan
line: Who are you?

title: The Infinite Vulcan
line: I am called Agmar. I believe we can help.

title: The Infinite Vulcan
line: Are you getting a reading on them?

title: The Infinite Vulcan
line: A moment, Captain. The results are unclear.

title: The Infinite Vulcan
line: Now, just a minute. I can't let you, whatever you are, inject him with some alien dew drop!

title: The Infinite Vulcan
line: To wait is to assure your friend's death. I must proceed.

title: The Infinite Vulcan
line: Bones, let them help.

title: The Infinite Vulcan
line: Captain, these beings are of botanical origin.

title: The Infinite Vulcan
line: Intelligent plants?

title: The Infinite Vulcan
line: So it would seem.

title: The Infinite Vulcan
line: It is an antidote quickly absorbed. He should begin to respond momentarily.

title: The Infinite Vulcan
line: Thank you.

title: The Infinite Vulcan
line: Welcome to the planet Phylos.

title: The Infinite Vulcan
line: I'm Captain James Kirk. Mister Spock, Doctor McCoy and Mister Sulu. You seem to have been expecting us.

title: The Infinite Vulcan
line: Our instruments have tracked and scanned you. We did not wish to reveal ourselves immediately. We are a peaceful race and we have a fear of aliens.

title: The Infinite Vulcan
line: What happened to him?

title: The Infinite Vulcan
line: He was bitten by the Retlaw plant. It is deadly only if unattended.

title: The Infinite Vulcan
line: Your medication worked quickly.

title: The Infinite Vulcan
line: A minor achievement.

title: The Infinite Vulcan
line: Minor? Our science doesn't have anything that works that fast. Yours must be incredible. The toxin level is decreasing fast. Body readings up to normal. How is it you knew your antidote would work on a human?

title: The Infinite Vulcan
line: There have been humanoid aliens here before.

title: The Infinite Vulcan
line: Your method of communication

title: The Infinite Vulcan
line: A voder, or translator. Most efficient.

title: The Infinite Vulcan
line: I'm sorry, Agmar, but I don't like puzzles. Where are the rest of your people?

title: The Infinite Vulcan
line: Come. I will show you.

title: The Infinite Vulcan
line: Our people.

title: The Infinite Vulcan
line: Nerve tissue. Mass density is exceptionally high. Readings indicate the beings used almost seventy percent of their brains. A very high ratio.

title: The Infinite Vulcan
line: Your ancestors?

title: The Infinite Vulcan
line: No, only the generation before us.

title: The Infinite Vulcan
line: Then, what happened?

title: The Infinite Vulcan
line: A human came. He brought sickness and death. But he also worked to save us from his disease.

title: The Infinite Vulcan
line: There are evidences of gram-positive bacteria. It's carried by humanoids without ill effect, but staphylococcus strains don't seem to be native to this planet. It must have been like a plague.

title: The Infinite Vulcan
line: We had no way of knowing what was happening.

title: The Infinite Vulcan
line: You were alive then?

title: The Infinite Vulcan
line: Very young.

title: The Infinite Vulcan
line: Plant life, Captain. Primitive and aggressive.

title: The Infinite Vulcan
line: They won't work on any setting, sir.

title: The Infinite Vulcan
line: There is a weapons deactivator in effect here. Your destructive machines will have no effect.

title: The Infinite Vulcan
line: I think it's after you, Jim.

title: The Infinite Vulcan

title: The Infinite Vulcan
line: Captain!

title: The Infinite Vulcan
line: What do you think they'll do with us, sir?

title: The Infinite Vulcan
line: Something tells me we've just been used as a diversionary tactic. Look.

title: The Infinite Vulcan
line: I'm sorry, Captain Kirk, but there was no other way.

title: The Infinite Vulcan
line: What are you talking about? Where have they taken Spock?

title: The Infinite Vulcan
line: He has been chosen to serve a greater cause. The Master has searched many years to find a specimen like Spock. And now, all the worlds of the galaxy will share in the beauty of peace and harmony.

title: The Infinite Vulcan
line: So help me, if you don't tell me where Spock has been taken

title: The Infinite Vulcan
line: The Master. Praise to the Master. The Master, our Savior. Savior, our Master.

title: The Infinite Vulcan
line: Another plant?

title: The Infinite Vulcan
line: No, definitely human, Jim.

title: The Infinite Vulcan
line: I am Doctor Stavos Keniclius Five. Welcome to Phylos, Captain Kirk.

title: The Infinite Vulcan
line: Where is Spock?

title: The Infinite Vulcan
line: He is mine. The essence of him is mine. Return to your ship. Here is your communicator. Go back to your ship.

title: The Infinite Vulcan
line: Not without my First Officer.

title: The Infinite Vulcan
line: I am sorry, Captain. You will leave now or suffer the consequences.

title: The Infinite Vulcan
line: Kirk to Enterprise. Beam us up, Scotty.

title: The Infinite Vulcan
line: Captain's log, stardate 5554.8. We have come upon one of the most fascinating diskoveries we have ever seen. Plant life of extraordinary intelligence and technology. However, they have captured Mister Spock, apparently under the orders of a human named Keniclius. Lieutenant Uhura is trying to locate any reference to such a man in order to unravel the mystery of this giant human.

title: The Infinite Vulcan
line: Anything, Mister Sulu?

title: The Infinite Vulcan
line: We haven't been able to pick up any human life form readings, sir. Spock and Keniclius must be somewhere our sensors can't penetrate.

title: The Infinite Vulcan
line: What about the Phylosians?

title: The Infinite Vulcan
line: I had to adjust for the fact that they're plant life forms. We're registering the lesser ones like the Swoopers in abundance. No sign of Agmar and the other four.

title: The Infinite Vulcan
line: Agmar said something about a weapons deactivator. Mister Sulu, lock ship's phasers on that laboratory building. Use a wide area stun setting.

title: The Infinite Vulcan
line: Aye, sir.

title: The Infinite Vulcan
line: Lieutenant Uhura, how are you coming with that information on Keniclius?

title: The Infinite Vulcan
line: Nothing current, Captain. I may have found something in the history banks. I'll have it in a moment.

title: The Infinite Vulcan
line: Keep trying, Lieutenant.

title: The Infinite Vulcan
line: Phasers locked on and ready, sir.

title: The Infinite Vulcan
line: Fire phasers.

title: The Infinite Vulcan
line: Firing. No effect, Captain. Phaser stun was neutralized at a distance of one thousand meters above the area.

title: The Infinite Vulcan
line: Which means our weapons are useless, and we have no alternative but to go back down there and try to rescue Spock without them.

title: The Infinite Vulcan
line: I'd hate to resort to clubs and knives.

title: The Infinite Vulcan
line: There may be something more effective, Mister Sulu. Kirk to Engineering. Scotty?

title: The Infinite Vulcan
line: Here, sir.

title: The Infinite Vulcan
line: How's that special equipment coming along?

title: The Infinite Vulcan
line: My engineers are working on it now, sir. You'll have it within the hour.

title: The Infinite Vulcan
line: Very well, Mister Scott. Kirk out.

title: The Infinite Vulcan
line: I have the information now, sir. I'll put it on the main screen.

title: The Infinite Vulcan
line: Thank you, Lieutenant. Bones?

title: The Infinite Vulcan
line: One of my great great granddaddies, way back, had the finest garden in the South. Had to scramble around a little bit to find the materials, but I've got his recipe brewing now.

title: The Infinite Vulcan
line: Working. From Earth history file. Stavos Keniclius. Earth scientist, period, Eugenics Wars.

title: The Infinite Vulcan
line: Planned to clone perfect specimen prototype into master race. Concept considered anti-humanistic. Banned from community. Disappeared. No evidence of death. No further data.

title: The Infinite Vulcan
line: There used to be a story about a modern Diogenes wandering the galaxy looking for someone special.

title: The Infinite Vulcan
line: Someone special. A perfect specimen, perhaps. Yes, I've heard it too.

title: The Infinite Vulcan
line: It couldn't be Keniclius. He'd be over two hundred and fifty years old.

title: The Infinite Vulcan
line: Not if he cloned a new copy of himself every so often to carry on the search. Remember, he said he was Keniclius Five.

title: The Infinite Vulcan
line: It seems incredible that a man could take a few cells from his body and reproduce himself from them time after time. But that seems to be exactly what we're dealing with in the giant human Keniclius.

title: The Infinite Vulcan
line: I hope these things work.

title: The Infinite Vulcan
line: Well, the equipment's guaranteed, but I have my doubts about the stuff inside. A strange way to handle aliens.

title: The Infinite Vulcan
line: These are strange aliens we're fighting. Scotty, as soon as we beam down, I want you to leave orbit. If they think we've gone, they won't be scanning the surface. Give us thirty minutes.

title: The Infinite Vulcan
line: Aye, sir, but I don't like it.

title: The Infinite Vulcan
line: Neither do I, but it appears to be necessary. Energize.

title: The Infinite Vulcan
line: No indication of a scan. I don't think they know we're here.

title: The Infinite Vulcan
line: Let's go.

title: The Infinite Vulcan
line: I'm not sure I can take too much of this.

title: The Infinite Vulcan
line: They're almost mindless, Doctor. They seem to attack primarily as a reflex action. It's clear now.

title: The Infinite Vulcan
line: I can't believe it.

title: The Infinite Vulcan
line: Incredible.

title: The Infinite Vulcan
line: Looks like they're getting ready to go on a trip.

title: The Infinite Vulcan
line: But where? To what purpose? The number of ships indicates a mass migration. Or invasion.

title: The Infinite Vulcan
line: Agmar said they were a peaceful people.

title: The Infinite Vulcan
line: Sure they are, now. But what about before?

title: The Infinite Vulcan
line: You could have a point, Bones. Those ships, the city. The Phylosians built a technology possibly greater than we animal species did.

title: The Infinite Vulcan
line: The ships look like they never got off the ground. Could be the disease Keniclius accidentally brought here swept the planet before they could do whatever they were going to do.

title: The Infinite Vulcan
line: Any indication of Keniclius or Spock?

title: The Infinite Vulcan
line: No, sir. Only the Phylosians.

title: The Infinite Vulcan
line: Well, followers can be led. Let's hope we can be as persuasive as Keniclius.

title: The Infinite Vulcan
line: Agmar, we don't want to hurt you, but we must have Spock back.

title: The Infinite Vulcan
line: I do not think that is possible. The Vulcan-human blend of wisdom, sense of order, durability and strength is the finest the Master has ever found. We are pleased Spock will carry on our work.

title: The Infinite Vulcan
line: Carry on your work?

title: The Infinite Vulcan
line: We are the last of a dying people, Captain. Once we had a great mission. Then disease decimated us. We few are the frail remnant of what survived. Our spore cells have been destroyed. There will be no more of our kind.

title: The Infinite Vulcan
line: What if something happens to Spock or the Master?

title: The Infinite Vulcan
line: There will always be a master. But come, you are worried about your friend. I will show you he is safe and in good hands.

title: The Infinite Vulcan
line: Just like that, Captain?

title: The Infinite Vulcan
line: So it would appear, Mister Sulu. All the same, keep that bag handy.

title: The Infinite Vulcan
line: The way is though here, gentlemen.

title: The Infinite Vulcan
line: We sprang from the soil, Captain. These tunnels were once part of our home. This will serve to illuminate our way.

title: The Infinite Vulcan
line: No wonder we couldn't find Spock. The walls are six hundred times denser than lead, in addition to the surface force field.

title: The Infinite Vulcan
line: Did you hear something?

title: The Infinite Vulcan
line: What?

title: The Infinite Vulcan
line: I'm not sure.

title: The Infinite Vulcan
line: Not much further now, Captain.

title: The Infinite Vulcan
line: There it is again. A flapping sound. Agmar!

title: The Infinite Vulcan
line: Use the belt lights!

title: The Infinite Vulcan

title: The Infinite Vulcan
line: Run. We've got to find some light. We can't do anything unless we can see what we're fighting. Don't stop. Try to stay together.

title: The Infinite Vulcan
line: Jim, up ahead.

title: The Infinite Vulcan
line: I see it. I see it. Keep going.

title: The Infinite Vulcan
line: He's dying. Something's happened to his brain. Electrical activity decreasing.

title: The Infinite Vulcan
line: It's too late, Captain Kirk! In a few minutes your friend will be gone. But as Keniclius One lives on in each of his clones, so will Mister Spock. Behold, gentlemen, the dawning of a new era, the salvation of a galaxy! Spock Two!

title: The Infinite Vulcan
line: Get ready.

line: Captain, I'm out. The chemical sprayer is empty.

line: Maybe they're waiting for the mist to clear. Well, how about that. Great granddaddy's weed spray still works.

title: The Infinite Vulcan
line: Never mind that. We've got to get Spock out of here before Keniclius returns. Scott should have the Enterprise back by now. Kirk to Enterprise. Kirk to Enterprise. Nothing. Must be these blasted walls again. Kirk to Enterprise.

title: The Infinite Vulcan
line: It's no use, Jim. He'll be dead in a few minutes. His mind is gone. He no longer thinks. This machine has drained his mind somehow.

title: The Infinite Vulcan
line: More than just drained. It's been transferred, relocated into the mechanism itself. I can duplicate exact physiological structure. I cannot duplicate that which is learned. Just as my predecessor transferred his knowledge to me through his apparatus, I have done that with Mister Spock and the first of his clones.

title: The Infinite Vulcan
line: You talk about creating life with your clones, but you have to murder to do it. Come on.

title: The Infinite Vulcan
line: Out of my way, mister. That's an order.

title: The Infinite Vulcan
line: I don't think he understands. His mind is still trying to assimilate all the knowledge it's been fed.

title: The Infinite Vulcan
line: Keep trying, Lieutenant. We've got to make contact with the Captain.

title: The Infinite Vulcan
line: It's no use, Mister Scott. I can't get through.

title: The Infinite Vulcan
line: Except for environmental systems, I want the entire power load of this ship redirected into a tight beam transmission. If we can break through the shielding, we can reach the Captain.

title: The Infinite Vulcan
line: Mister Scott, you're risking a total drain of our dilithium crystals. To maintain communication we would have to burn out all our reserves.

title: The Infinite Vulcan
line: And don't I know it, lass. But we must speak to the Captain.

title: The Infinite Vulcan
line: He's coming out of it, Jim. He's becoming conscious and aware.

title: The Infinite Vulcan
line: Spock, what is the logic in letting a man die for the sake of creating his duplicate? Explain it to me, sir. Explain it to me.

title: The Infinite Vulcan
line: All power sources locked in, Mister Scott.

title: The Infinite Vulcan
line: Then throw the switch, Lieutenant.

title: The Infinite Vulcan
line: Vulcans do not condone the meaningless death of any being. Spock's death is meaningless if it is only to create a giant version of himself.

title: The Infinite Vulcan
line: It is not just a duplicate. He will be the beginning of a master race. He

line: That's our ship calling, Spock. You answer them.

title: The Infinite Vulcan
line: Spock is slipping away. There isn't much time left.

title: The Infinite Vulcan
line: I'm sure we're getting through, but they're not acknowledging.

line: Keep trying.

line: Mister Scott, we're near the drain point on the dilithium crystals now. Our reserves

title: The Infinite Vulcan
line: Commander Spock here.

title: The Infinite Vulcan
line: Oh, thank heaven. Mister Spock, tell the Captain I've located more information about Keniclius.

title: The Infinite Vulcan
line: I had the library computer check out all known writings by Keniclius. They are obscure, but there is a recurring theme in his later essays about using his master race as a peace-keeping force throughout the galaxy.

title: The Infinite Vulcan
line: That was why Keniclius wanted a perfect specimen. I have to sign off. We've reached power drain threshold.

title: The Infinite Vulcan
line: That's what I call close, Mister Scott.

title: The Infinite Vulcan
line: Let's hope it was information they could use.

title: The Infinite Vulcan
line: All this has been a waste, Keniclius. There's been peace in the Federation for over one hundred years.

title: The Infinite Vulcan
line: That is a lie. What about the Eugenics Wars? The galactic wars? What of the depredations of the Romulans, the Klingons and the Kzinti? An army of Spock duplicates is necessary to subdue them.

title: The Infinite Vulcan
line: You're the fifth Keniclius. What makes you so sure what you believe is truth isn't just old news? Your predecessors could have been out of touch with our advances for two centuries.

title: The Infinite Vulcan
line: The Master always speaks the truth.

title: The Infinite Vulcan
line: I can understand why you think Keniclius is the master if he saved you from dying, but why do you agree with his plan of a super race?

title: The Infinite Vulcan
line: Our fleet of ships which you saw was to be launched for the same purpose the Master intends. Disease struck us before we could carry out our own plan to impose peace on a galaxy that knew none.

title: The Infinite Vulcan
line: We already have peace in the Federation. It wasn't imposed, it was agreed upon. You have no need of Spock. Reverse the effects of that machine and let us take him.

title: The Infinite Vulcan
line: No! The mold must be broken.

title: The Infinite Vulcan
line: Jim, Spock's almost gone.

title: The Infinite Vulcan
line: If you have Spock's mind, you'll know the Vulcan symbol called the IDIC.

title: The Infinite Vulcan
line: Infinite Diversity in Infinite Combinations. Symbolizing the elements that create truth and beauty.

title: The Infinite Vulcan
line: Could an army of Spocks impose peace and Phylosian philosophy on any other beings in defiance of the IDIC concept?

title: The Infinite Vulcan
line: I do not believe so.

title: The Infinite Vulcan
line: Reverse the machine, Keniclius.

title: The Infinite Vulcan
line: No! Our dream must not be allowed to die.

title: The Infinite Vulcan
line: Murderer! You've killed Spock!

title: The Infinite Vulcan
line: To persist in this behavior, Captain, is to negate the eloquence of your previous argument. May I suggest a more constructive way?

title: The Infinite Vulcan
line: My mind to your mind, my thoughts to your thoughts.

title: The Infinite Vulcan
line: The Vulcan mind touch.

title: The Infinite Vulcan
line: I am pleasantly surprised at your capacity for deductive reasoning, Captain. When you are not being bellicose, there appears to be no end to your arsenal of formidable talents.

title: The Infinite Vulcan
line: Spock. Spock, you old

title: The Infinite Vulcan
line: And you needn't worry, Captain Kirk, about a master race. There will be no militia, no other Spocks.

title: The Infinite Vulcan
line: But what of my work? If all I have lived for is already done, if the times I feared are gone, what is to become of me? There appears to be no reason why I should continue to exist.

title: The Infinite Vulcan
line: I would suggest Doctor Keniclius remain on Phylos with my duplicate. The concerted efforts of both scientists may yet achieve a rebirth of the Phylosian civilisation and enable them to contribute to the Federation.

title: The Infinite Vulcan
line: My thoughts exactly, Mister Spock.

title: The Infinite Vulcan
line: So one might assume, Mister Spock.

title: The Infinite Vulcan
line: How does that sound to you, Keniclius? To bring life is at least as important as bringing peace.

title: The Infinite Vulcan
line: I would be honored. If I will be allowed.

title: The Infinite Vulcan
line: I'll report your work here. I think the Federation will understand.

title: The Infinite Vulcan
line: By the way, Mister Sulu, any chance of teaching me that body throw? Could come in handy sometime.

title: The Infinite Vulcan
line: I don't know, sir. It isn't just physical, you know. You have to be inscrutable.

title: The Infinite Vulcan
line: Inscrutable? Sulu, you're the most scrutable man I know.

title: Yesteryear

title: Yesteryear

title: Yesteryear

title: Yesteryear

line: I do not recall clearly. I was very young. He called himself Selek. He was visiting us, but I never saw him after that.

line: Yes. I will need a Vulcan desert soft suit and boots, and a small selection of streetwear circa 8877 Vulcan years. The carry bag should be of the same period.

line: Nice to know the crew is efficient in this time plane, too. Spock.

line: I wish to visit the planet Vulcan, thirty years past, the month of Tasmeen. Location, near the city of ShirKahr.

title: Yesteryear
line: The time and place are ready to receive you. Personal log, stardate 5373.5, subjective time. I have returned to the past in an attempt to restore the future. I am home and I had almost forgotten its beauty.

line: Earther! Barbarian! Emotional Earther! You're a Terran, Spock. You could never be a true Vulcan.

title: Beyond The Farthest Star

title: The Survivor
line: One of the many stories I've heard about you, Mister Winston. It's an honor for all of us to have you aboard.

title: The Survivor
line: There is one person aboard who should be especially happy to learn you are alive, Mister Winston. Lieutenant Anne Nored of our security detail.

title: The Survivor
line: My fiancee? Anne's aboard this starship?

title: The Survivor
line: We will notify her as soon as we've verified your credentials, Mister Winston. If you have your identity tapes with you

title: The Survivor
line: Spock! Of all the cold-blooded, inhospitable requests I've ever heard.

title: The Survivor
line: I believe our regulations are quite clear, Doctor. An immediate identity check and medical examination are a standard requirement at this point.

title: The Survivor
line: Spock is right as usual, Bones.

title: The Survivor
line: And I understand, of course. My credentials, Captain. The Enterprise has rescued a living legend, the foremost space trader of our time. Carter Winston has acquired a dozen fortunes only to use his wealth time and again to assist Federation colonies in times of need or disaster.

title: The Survivor
line: Library computer, verify record tape on Winston, Carter.

title: The Survivor
line: Working. Identification positive. Fingerprints positive. Voice print positive. All licenses and registration in order.

title: The Survivor
line: Visual display of owner. Checks out. It seems we'll have a distinguished passenger with us for a while.

title: The Survivor
line: Is there some problem, Doctor?

title: The Survivor
line: This instrument seems a little off. I've never gotten quite this reading from a human before.

title: The Survivor
line: Are you suggesting I'm not quite human, Doctor?

title: The Survivor
line: Of course not. Anyway, it's just a fraction off normal. It's probably the instrument. They need to be recalibrated every so often.

title: The Survivor
line: The Captain is inquiring if the examination is completed, Doctor.

title: The Survivor
line: Yes, I suppose so.

title: The Survivor
line: And Lieutenant Nored is waiting to see Mister Winston once you've certified his medical condition.

title: The Survivor
line: Well, I certainly don't want to keep you any longer from your fiancee. Show her in.

title: The Survivor
line: Oh, Carter.

title: The Survivor
line: I'm sorry, Anne. I never thought we would meet again.

title: The Survivor
line: Carter, what is it?

title: The Survivor
line: When I left on that last trip, I fully intended to come back and marry you, but my ship was disabled and I crashed on Vendor. I'm told I was lucky I survived.

title: The Survivor
line: But you did survive. You're alive, and we're together again.

title: The Survivor
line: Anne, I'm changed. First there was surgery, skin graft, regrowth of bone. After they put me together, they assigned one of their people to me, and he nursed me back to health.

title: The Survivor
line: But, you said you've changed. How? I don't see any change.

title: The Survivor
line: It's over between us, Anne. I'm sorry, I can't explain why but, I can't marry you. Ever.

title: The Survivor
line: Take the conn, Mister Spock. I'll be in my cabin completing the report on Winston's rescue.

title: The Survivor
line: Come.

title: The Survivor
line: I hope I'm not intruding, Captain.

title: The Survivor
line: No, please come in, Mister Winston.

title: The Survivor
line: I've been down to examine my ship. They stowed it in the shuttlebay.

title: The Survivor
line: Yes, I'm afraid it's pretty badly damaged. It's hardly worth salvaging right now. I've had our engineering officer, Mister Scott, examine it and make a report. It's here somewhere. He doesn't think there's anything left in your ship except scrap value.

title: The Survivor
line: Well, I can't find anything wrong with these instruments, Doctor. They check out, but the readings are still slightly off. What about the rest of the tests on Winston?

title: The Survivor
line: Well, some are off and some aren't. It has to be our error. Come on. We'll start from the beginning and this time we're going to find the answer.

title: The Survivor
line: Weren't you going to your cabin, sir?

title: The Survivor
line: Mister Sulu, lay in a direct course for Ratar Three.

title: The Survivor
line: Through the Romulan Neutral Zone, sir?

title: The Survivor
line: That was the order, helmsman.

title: The Survivor
line: But sir, if we're caught there, the Romulans can confiscate the ship. The treaty

title: The Survivor
line: I know the terms of the treaty, Mister Sulu, and I believe you heard my order.

title: The Survivor
line: Aye, aye, sir.

title: The Survivor
line: Captain, the extreme long-range sensors show something in the Zone. At this distance, I cannot determine precisely what it is. It could be a trading vessel like Winston's. But it does not seem prudent to take the risk of trespass into the Zone.

title: The Survivor
line: Mister Spock, I've spoken to Winston on this at some length. He has assured me it is absolutely vital to get to Ratar Three in the shortest possible time. The survival of the entire planetary population may depend on it.

title: The Survivor
line: An admirable mission, Captain, but if we endanger our ship

title: The Survivor
line: I wouldn't have ordered it if I didn't feel it safe, Spock. Winston says his sensors detected no Romulans when he came through the Zone last week. I'm satisfied he's telling the truth, and his word is considered good. Isn't it?

title: The Survivor
line: That has been his reputation.

title: The Survivor
line: Course laid in, sir.

title: The Survivor
line: Execute.

title: The Survivor
line: On course, sir.

title: The Survivor
line: You have the conn, Mister Spock. Ship's log, stardate 5148.7. First Officer Spock recording. The Captain's course change has taken us deep into the Romulan Neutral Zone.

title: The Survivor
line: I'll take the conn, Mister Spock.

title: The Survivor
line: Is something wrong, Captain?

title: The Survivor
line: I'm not sure. I went down to my quarters to dictate the accident report and I seem to have fallen asleep. I've never done that before.

title: The Survivor
line: Perhaps you needed the rest. We are on course through the Neutral Zone, sir.

title: The Survivor
line: The Neutral Zone? We have no authorisation to enter it. Did you order a course change, Spock?

title: The Survivor
line: No, sir. You did.

title: The Survivor
line: Ridiculous. No captain of the Starfleet would do that unless it was a matter of life and death.

title: The Survivor
line: I believe that was the reason you gave, Captain.

title: The Survivor
line: Weren't you going to your cabin, sir?

title: The Survivor
line: Mister Sulu, lay in a direct course for Ratar Three.

title: The Survivor
line: Through the Romulan Neutral Zone, sir?

title: The Survivor
line: That was an order, helmsman.

title: The Survivor
line: That's enough, Spock. Mister Scott, take the conn. Spock. Mister Sulu, plot a course to take the Enterprise out of the Neutral Zone at warp eight. Lieutenant M'Ress, put the ship on Yellow Alert.

title: The Survivor
line: Mister Spock, I don't remember giving those orders. I left the Bridge, went to my quarters and fell asleep. That's all.

title: The Survivor
line: Perhaps Doctor McCoy should examine you, Captain.

title: The Survivor
line: Definitely. I've become subject to blackouts, I'm a possible danger to the safety of the ship. I can't allow that.

title: The Survivor
line: Oh, Winston. I was just finishing the tests I ran on you. I don't think

title: The Survivor
line: Doctor McCoy?

title: The Survivor
line: Can I help you?

title: The Survivor
line: I don't know, Doctor. I just thought. Well, I have to talk to someone.

title: The Survivor
line: Oh now, let me guess. It's you and Carter Winston. He told me a little about it when I examined him.

title: The Survivor
line: Doctor, what do I do? I still love him.

title: The Survivor
line: Well, I'm sure he'd like to feel the same way about you, Anne, but that may be impossible. Five years, that's a long time. People change.

title: The Survivor
line: I haven't. What can I do?

title: The Survivor
line: Well, if he asked you to forget him, I think you should try to do just that. Do you think he'd want to deceive you?

title: The Survivor
line: Oh no. He's the gentlest, most thoughtful man I've ever known.

title: The Survivor
line: Yes, but, my dear, if he doesn't want you and he has asked you to forget him, then I suggest you take that as an honest concern for you and do it. Forget Winston.

title: The Survivor
line: Thank you, Doctor. I'll consider your advice.

title: The Survivor
line: What can I do for you, Captain?

title: The Survivor
line: I want a complete medical examination, Bones. Something's just happened

title: The Survivor
line: I'm afraid I'll have to make it later today, Captain. I have too many tests to process right now.

title: The Survivor
line: Carter Winston's?

title: The Survivor
line: That one's done. Tested out normal.

title: The Survivor
line: Are you sure there is no possibility you made an error?

title: The Survivor
line: Well, there's always that possibility. I'll go over them again if you like.

title: The Survivor
line: No, that won't be necessary. I'll come by later for that examination. Let's go, Spock.

title: The Survivor
line: Captain, did you notice Doctor McCoy's reaction when I asked him if there was any possibility he might have made an error?

title: The Survivor
line: He said there's always that possibility. And that's not like Bones at all. Come on.

title: The Survivor
line: There are not many places one could hide in here.

title: The Survivor
line: I must have taken a little nap.

title: The Survivor
line: Doctor, you are a man of curious habits, but I have never known you to nap on the laboratory floor.

title: The Survivor
line: There's something wrong about this room.

title: The Survivor
line: All right, Winston. You can come out now. I suggest you show yourself, Winston, or whatever you are.

title: The Survivor
line: Did you say I'm a man of curious habits? Jim's talking to a table.

title: The Survivor
line: I don't think so, Doctor.

title: The Survivor
line: There used to be only two examining tables in this room. Now there are three.

title: The Survivor
line: I just realized that.

title: The Survivor
line: This is a vial of Orientine acid, Winston. It will burn through almost anything but this crystal. If you've never seen it work, I'll demonstrate on you.

title: The Survivor
line: I saw that, but I don't believe it.

title: The Survivor
line: A Vendorian, Doctor. Their planet is quarantined, and few people ever do see them. Their ability to rearrange their molecular structure into anything with the same general size and mass and their practice of deceit as a way of life puts them off limits.

title: The Survivor
line: Mister Spock, get a security team down here on the double.

title: The Survivor
line: Jim!

title: The Survivor
line: Spock to Bridge. Put me on ship's audio.

title: The Survivor
line: All security teams, intruder alert. Repeat, intruder alert. The intruder is a Vendorian capable of assuming any shape or identity. (It changes into Carter Winston and looks for somewhere to hide. A phaser is pointed at it)

title: The Survivor
line: Anne, what are you doing?

title: The Survivor
line: My job. It isn't hard to guess who the intruder is. You're the only stranger aboard, Carter.

title: The Survivor
line: Lieutenant Nored, you could've stopped him. Why didn't you fire?

title: The Survivor
line: I, I couldn't. I knew he had to be the intruder, Captain, but I couldn't harm the image of the man I loved.

title: The Survivor
line: Lieutenant, he is not the man you loved. Carter Winston is dead.

title: The Survivor
line: I know that too, now.

title: The Survivor
line: Security teams report no sign of the alien on this deck, Captain.

title: The Survivor
line: I was afraid of that. Once out of our sight, he can become anyone or anything aboard this ship.

title: The Survivor
line: Bridge, this is the Captain. What's happened?

title: The Survivor
line: Two Romulan battle cruisers, Captain. And they're heading right for us.

title: The Survivor
line: Captain's log, supplemental. Due to interference by the alien Vendorian aboard, the Enterprise has been detected violating the Romulan Neutral Zone. By the terms of our treaty, the Romulans have a legal right to seize and impound the Enterprise. To complicate matters, we have not been able to apprehend the Vendorian responsible for putting us in this position.

title: The Survivor
line: You appear to have a propensity for trespassing in the Neutral Zone, Captain Kirk.

title: The Survivor
line: It was not deliberate, I assure you.

title: The Survivor
line: It never is. But the rules of the treaty are clear. To contravene them would mean war. You will surrender your ship, Captain. We will release you and your crew at the nearest outpost that guards the Neutral Zone.

title: The Survivor
line: I'd like a few minutes to inform my crew.

title: The Survivor
line: Very well. Five minutes, no more.

title: The Survivor
line: Kirk to Security. What's the status on the search for the Vendorian?

title: The Survivor
line: No progress yet. We have all decks patrolled, but no one has seen him.

title: The Survivor
line: Carry on, Lieutenant. The Romulans were expecting us, Mister Spock. That wreck of Winston's ship was the bait to get a Romulan spy onboard. And what better spy than a Vendorian who can shape at will. When I went down to my cabin, he must have put me out long enough for him to return to the Bridge and order the course change.

title: The Survivor
line: It would seem so.

title: The Survivor
line: Open a hailing frequency Lieutenant M'Ress.

title: The Survivor
line: Hailing frequency open, sir. They're waiting for us.

title: The Survivor
line: I assume you are now ready to turn your ship over to us, Captain.

title: The Survivor
line: Wrong assumption.

title: The Survivor
line: Captain, you are outnumbered, outgunned and in the wrong. I admire your courage, but I

title: The Survivor
line: I have no choice, Commander. You lured me here in direct violation of the treaty.

title: The Survivor
line: Lured, Captain? How could we lure a Starfleet vessel into the Neutral Zone?

title: The Survivor
line: Through the use of a spy using the human form of Carter Winston.

title: The Survivor
line: A spy? Come now, Captain. Your imagination is creative but obviously out of control.

title: The Survivor
line: You used a Vendorian, which, I might add, is also a violation of the treaty.

title: The Survivor
line: Your five minutes are up, Captain. Either surrender your ship or prepare to fight.

title: The Survivor
line: I will not surrender my ship.

title: The Survivor
line: What are you doing?

title: The Survivor
line: Captain, our deflector shields are coming down.

title: The Survivor
line: Bridge to Engineering. Scotty, what's happened to the shields?

title: The Survivor
line: Mister Scott isn't here, sir.

title: The Survivor
line: Get those shields

title: The Survivor
line: Up again now.

title: The Survivor
line: I can't, sir.

title: The Survivor
line: Hangar doors on the shuttlecraft deck are opening, sir. The Vendorian must be trying to escape.

title: The Survivor
line: We need him. Override the controls and shut those doors.

title: The Survivor
line: Doors closing, sir.

title: The Survivor
line: Spock, take the conn. Talk to the Romulans. Try to stall them. And send a security team to the hangar deck. I'll be in Engineering.

title: The Survivor
line: I don't know, sir. I came up here to check the backup systems, and there was a crewman taking this panel apart. That's all I remember.

title: The Survivor
line: How long will it take to fix?

title: The Survivor
line: Two hours, at least.

title: The Survivor
line: Get on it.

title: The Survivor
line: You're not getting past me this time. I've learned my lesson.

title: The Survivor
line: Yes. He said you were like that, practical as well as warm and lovely. You're everything he said you were.

title: The Survivor
line: Carter? What did he say?

title: The Survivor
line: Many things. Some were only feelings, deep feelings he couldn't always express. He did love you.

title: The Survivor
line: How did he die?

title: The Survivor
line: Winston crashed on our planet, and he was tended by a Vendorian. Me. He lived for almost a year before his body ceased to function.

title: The Survivor
line: You are so much like him, his voice, his mannerisms.

title: The Survivor
line: That is the way of our people. The longer we stay in another's form, the more we take on its memory, emotion, attitudes. Not totally, but a great deal as time passes.

title: The Survivor
line: He did say he loved me.

title: The Survivor
line: As I do. In a sense, I feel some of the emotions he felt. His love for you was very strong. Because I was there, it did not end when he died.

title: The Survivor
line: Carter.

title: The Survivor
line: Anne, this is what I am. Can you love this? You see why I told you it would be best to forget me?

title: The Survivor
line: But unfortunately, I can't.

title: The Survivor
line: Direct hit, Captain. Damage to the secondary propulsion system. The commander has apparently decided to fight.

title: The Survivor
line: The Romulan commander is signaling, sir. I'll put it on the screen.

title: The Survivor
line: Captain Kirk, all our main batteries are trained on you. To resist would be useless and wasteful of lives. Do you surrender?

title: The Survivor
line: Without deflectors, we're just a clay pigeon for them.

title: The Survivor
line: Practicality does suggest capitulation, Captain.

title: The Survivor
line: Captain, the deflector shields are coming up again.

title: The Survivor
line: That's only one shield.

title: The Survivor
line: Yes, sir, but it is between us and the Romulans.

title: The Survivor
line: Mister Sulu, aim for the propulsion units of the lead Romulan vessel. Prepare to fire phasers and photon torpedoes in combination.

title: The Survivor
line: Phasers and torpedoes ready, sir.

title: The Survivor
line: Fire.

title: The Survivor
line: Second vessel firing now, sir.

title: The Survivor
line: Lock on second target.

title: The Survivor
line: Ready, Captain.

title: The Survivor
line: Fire.

title: The Survivor
line: Strange. We did no damage, but the Romulan is retreating anyway.

title: The Survivor
line: They may believe we do have their spy. Scan the other vessel for damage, if you will, Mister Spock.

title: The Survivor
line: Second vessel power supply out. Crew unharmed. They should be able to repair the ship in a few days.

title: The Survivor
line: Good work, Mister Scott. That deflector shield went up just in time.

title: The Survivor
line: But sir, I haven't finished repairing the shield. I told you it'll take hours, and it will.

title: The Survivor
line: Interesting.

title: The Survivor
line: Then what was? Winston.

title: The Survivor
line: It is not outside the realm of probability. If he could rearrange his own atoms to become an examination table, one would have to assume he could become a deflector shield.

title: The Survivor
line: Will someone tell me what's going on?

title: The Survivor
line: What manner of beastie is that?

title: The Survivor
line: Your deflector shield, Mister Scott.

title: The Survivor
line: I assume the danger to your ship is over.

title: The Survivor
line: It is.

title: The Survivor
line: As it should be. I'm sorry if I endangered your vessel.

title: The Survivor
line: Why did you do it?

title: The Survivor
line: Among my own people, I am a non-producer, useless. An outcast fit only to do those tasks of the lowest order. The Romulans offered me a life, something of value I could do. It is important to be of value to someone.

title: The Survivor
line: What changed your mind about the Romulans?

title: The Survivor
line: It seems, Captain, that I am more Carter Winston than I knew. He loved life. He loved Anne. I couldn't allow the Romulans to harm any of you because of him.

title: The Survivor
line: I understand.

title: The Survivor
line: What will happen to me now?

title: The Survivor
line: You'll have to stand trial. But you did save the Enterprise from the Romulans, and I will recommend that be taken into consideration.

title: The Survivor
line: Thank you, Captain.

title: The Survivor
line: In the meantime, I'm afraid I'll have to keep you under guard. I think we've had enough of that little trick.

title: The Survivor
line: Captain, could you assign me that duty.

title: The Survivor
line: But you've seem me. You know what I am.

title: The Survivor
line: Form doesn't seem terribly important to me. As Carter Winston or even just part of him, there's a better life for you than anything the Romulans might offer. Can we talk about that?

title: The Survivor
line: I don't know. I

title: The Survivor
line: You have the guard detail, Lieutenant.

title: The Survivor
line: You caught him.

title: The Survivor
line: Acute observation, Doctor.

title: The Survivor
line: I'm glad to see him under guard, Jim. If he'd turned into a second Spock, it would've been too much to take.

title: The Survivor
line: Perhaps. But then two Doctor McCoys just might bring the level of medical efficiency on this ship up to acceptable levels.

title: The Lorelei Signal
line: Captain's log, stardate 5483.7. The Enterprise is en route through an unfamiliar sector of space where a series of Earth Federation ships have disappeared mysteriously during the last a hundred and fifty years. Recent joint diskussions with the Klingon and Romulan Empires have revealed that a starship has disappeared in this sector precisely every twenty seven point three four six star years.

title: The Lorelei Signal
line: If my calculations are correct, Captain, we have twenty seconds to go.

title: The Lorelei Signal
line: Twenty seconds to what? That's what worries me. Lieutenant Uhura, place the ship on Yellow Alert.

title: The Lorelei Signal
line: Aye, sir. Yellow Alert.

title: The Lorelei Signal
line: Five seconds. Four, three

title: The Lorelei Signal
line: All stations report Yellow Alert status, sir. Captain, I'm getting some sort of subspace radio signal.

title: The Lorelei Signal
line: Put it on ship's speaker.

title: The Lorelei Signal
line: It's more like music than a message.

title: The Lorelei Signal
line: Captain, we are being probed.

title: The Lorelei Signal
line: From where? Can you trace it?

title: The Lorelei Signal
line: The signal is coming from a star system twenty light years away.

title: The Lorelei Signal
line: Can you identify it?

line: It is the Taurean system. A small star at the extreme edge of this sector.

title: The Lorelei Signal
line: That's a powerful signal to reach here from that great a distance.

title: The Lorelei Signal
line: It seems to be calling us.

title: The Lorelei Signal
line: Strange. Yes, I get the same feeling myself.

title: The Lorelei Signal
line: It does resemble a summons.

title: The Lorelei Signal
line: I find no resemblance to a summons, Captain.

title: The Lorelei Signal
line: Opinion noted. Set a course for the Taurean system, Lieutenant Arex. Warp factor seven.

title: The Lorelei Signal
line: You wanted me, Lieutenant? Are you all right?

title: The Lorelei Signal
line: I am. But I want you to observe the men here. It seemed to start when we picked up that signal, and it's gotten worse.

line: Fascinating. Like a Vulcan marriage drum. I am experiencing audio-visual suggestion, Captain.

title: The Lorelei Signal
line: So am I.

title: The Lorelei Signal
line: Dimensional visions. Any idea what's causing them, Spock?

line: Logically, we must assume they are created by the probe.

title: The Lorelei Signal
line: Sir, what visions? We don't see anything.

line: Miss Chapel, you don't see anything, either?

line: No, sir.

title: The Lorelei Signal
line: Magnolias in blossom. Beautiful.

title: The Lorelei Signal
line: The signal's getting stronger, sir.

line: Re-scan your sensor readings, Mister Spock.

line: Readings are still inconclusive. It is odd that only the men are affected, Captain. I suggest

line: Ship's log, stardate 5483.8. Engineering Officer Scott in command. We are in orbit around planet two in the Taurean system. Probes and sensors indicate there was once a vast civilisation here. line: These figures just don't match up with Spock's. So far I count three sensor readings that are off.

line: Fantastic architecture. Only an incredibly advanced race could have built it.

line: No, I don't think so, Carver. Spock will do it.

title: The Lorelei Signal
line: They are here.

line: I am Theela, the Head Female. Welcome, James Kirk, Doctor McCoy, Mister Spock. Welcome.

line: The form is humanoid, but there are many internal differences. Their bodies appear to function on an unusual psychokinesis level.

line: How do you know our names?

line: The Opto-aud revealed you to us.

line: Tonal control. Fascinating.

line: The Opto-aud will reveal whatever is asked, Mister Spock. We are grateful that you heard the signal, Captain.

line: The signal? A distress call, wasn't it?

line: Captain's log, stardate 5483.9. The beauty of this place is unequaled. It's the answer to all of man's dreams. Exquisite in every way. We're here to investigate, to investigate... The women radiate delight.

title: The Magicks of Megas-Tu
line: Probably because you're not very natural to begin with, Spock.

title: The Magicks of Megas-Tu
line: Look, Lucien, or whatever you want to call yourself, I want to know why you brought us here.

title: The Magicks of Megas-Tu
line: Children will play.

title: The Magicks of Megas-Tu
line: Is this better, my friends? I've translated my world into symbols your minds can understand. Welcome, my friends, to Megas-Tu.

title: The Magicks of Megas-Tu
line: And just exactly what is Megas-Tu?

title: The Magicks of Megas-Tu
line: A world, Captain James Kirk, that operates by rules quite different from those in your universe.

title: The Magicks of Megas-Tu
line: Our universe operates by what you superstitiously call magic.

title: The Magicks of Megas-Tu
line: I know this is just my imagination but

title: The Magicks of Megas-Tu
line: It is real, Doctor. Beautiful? No. But all our women are as young and beautiful as they want to be. So as to ensnare the man of her dreams, she needs an edge.

title: The Magicks of Megas-Tu
line: A love philter?

title: The Magicks of Megas-Tu
line: Never settle for anything less. Do you need a room, a stable, a castle? Stop in at your friendly sorcerer-contractor. Let him do the work.

title: The Magicks of Megas-Tu
line: Of course. Our Federation scientists were more correct than they realized. In order to function, the galactic creation point must extend through space, time, into another dimension where the logic of things is totally different.

title: The Magicks of Megas-Tu
line: It took magic to get your vessel working again. Magic you, my friends, don't know how to work. But then you never did know, did you.

title: The Magicks of Megas-Tu
line: Lucien, you keep calling us friends, implying that you know us. How?

title: The Magicks of Megas-Tu
line: Ah, Captain, Captain. to feign such ignorance to me. Very well. Look.

title: The Magicks of Megas-Tu
line: Megas-Tu may seem to you a chaotic world, but its people are calm, peaceful, contemplative, each a specialist in his own kind of magic. There are no rivals anywhere in our universe, Captain Kirk. No other life forms at all. Millennia ago, in our search for companionship, we Megans passed through the point between dimensions and eventually we found ourselves on your world, Earth. Wherever we went, we became advisors to mankind. To help your ancestors, we drew on the power left behind in our own universe and made it work in your world. But eventually we had to leave. I didn't want to, my friends. Oh, how I fought! I was the generalist amid all the specialists. The trouble-maker, they said. But I'd always loved the people of Earth. Those were the days. But now you've come to me, and I'm so very glad.

title: The Magicks of Megas-Tu
line: But why did you Megans leave Earth? If you enjoyed it so much, I don't understand.

title: The Magicks of Megas-Tu
line: Captain, good Captain, always so curious. That must be why I've always liked you Earthlings so much. No, you must go.

title: The Magicks of Megas-Tu
line: What is it? What's wrong?

title: The Magicks of Megas-Tu
line: You must return to your vessel. Quickly! Do not give your presence away.

title: The Magicks of Megas-Tu
line: Captain.

title: The Magicks of Megas-Tu
line: Captain Kirk, what

title: The Magicks of Megas-Tu
line: Everyone onboard is all right?

title: The Magicks of Megas-Tu
line: Fine, Captain. But you?

title: The Magicks of Megas-Tu
line: Mister Scott, I'm bewildered, that's all. But that's enough.

title: The Magicks of Megas-Tu
line: What did he mean, we're not to give ourselves away? Can't they detect the ship up here?

title: The Magicks of Megas-Tu
line: No, unless they have scanners. See, there. It's like a cloud of some kind. It's been between us and the planet since you vanished.

title: The Magicks of Megas-Tu
line: If Lucien put it there

title: The Magicks of Megas-Tu
line: If Lucien put it there, Captain, the questions become, why is he hiding us, and, what is our danger if diskovered by the rest of his people?

title: The Magicks of Megas-Tu
line: Weapons status, Mister Scott? We may have to protect ourselves.

title: The Magicks of Megas-Tu
line: No way, Captain. Everything's out but life support systems, and I can't figure out how they're on.

title: The Magicks of Megas-Tu
line: I believe this is how the ancients used to draw their mystic symbols, Captain.

title: The Magicks of Megas-Tu
line: Spock, do you honestly believe that as long as we're in this universe we can work magic too?

title: The Magicks of Megas-Tu
line: One uses the resources at hand, Captain. Watch now. I will attempt to move a Vulcan chess piece magically. May the energy of this universe be the power in me.

title: The Magicks of Megas-Tu
line: Forget it, Spock. It won't work.

title: The Magicks of Megas-Tu
line: It must work, Doctor. It is logical here. Power of this universe, enter my being. I know I can. I believe I can.

title: The Magicks of Megas-Tu
line: Captain's log, supplemental. In this incredible universe, it appears to be a part of the natural laws that belief is as potent a force as energy and matter are in our own.

title: The Magicks of Megas-Tu
line: Good luck.

title: The Magicks of Megas-Tu
line: What are you doing?

title: The Magicks of Megas-Tu
line: Learning to protect ourselves, Lucien.

title: The Magicks of Megas-Tu
line: Protect yourselves? Is that all human beings ever think about? I'll take care of you. That's what friends are for. All this mental energy you're using, it can be traced. You'll be found.

title: The Magicks of Megas-Tu
line: Have been found.

title: The Magicks of Megas-Tu
line: So, the people of Earth would spread their evil to our home? We are ready for human perfidy this time. This time, it is the humans who shall suffer, the humans and you, Lucien, who shall pay!

title: The Magicks of Megas-Tu
line: Keep calm.

title: The Magicks of Megas-Tu
line: It looks like ancient Earth, Spock. Sixteenth or seventeenth century, I'd guess.

title: The Magicks of Megas-Tu
line: Approximately 1691, Captain. Salem Massachusetts, if I recall your historical records correctly.

title: The Magicks of Megas-Tu
line: We are gathered here today, good citizens, to see justice done. You are the judges. These are the defendants, as representatives of the vilest species in all the universe, treacherous humanity, and those who would aid them. As a specialist in the ethics of magic, I have been appointed prosecutor here.

title: The Magicks of Megas-Tu
line: Wait. If this is a trial, we have the right to know what you think we've done.

title: The Magicks of Megas-Tu
line: Has this one not told you how we visited your Earth? Or what was done to us there?

title: The Magicks of Megas-Tu
line: Lucien has said only that you came as wise men, helpful wizards.

title: The Magicks of Megas-Tu
line: Then hear this. Know that one, upon your world, I was known as Asmodeus, he who sees all. Gaze upon my countenance, so that you too may see. We came to your world as friends. But wherever we went, the story was invariably the same. Some humans would attempt to use us to gain power, to serve their own greed and lust. When we refused to serve them, they turned against us and taught other humans to fear us, to hate. They called us devils, warlocks, evil sorcerers. Those of us who survived came to the town of Salem in Massachusetts, as settlers, and tried to live like other men.

title: The Magicks of Megas-Tu
line: But you made mistakes, used your powers

title: The Magicks of Megas-Tu
line: And burned for it. Burned!

title: The Magicks of Megas-Tu
line: As witches.

title: The Magicks of Megas-Tu
