line: We massed together, outside the town, immersed ourselves in Megan lore, revived ourselves enough to unite our minds and reach into our own universe, tap enough of its power to return from your hellish Earth to Megas-Tu.

title: The Magicks of Megas-Tu
line: And loneliness and fear

title: The Magicks of Megas-Tu
line: Should we not fear the Earthlings? Should we not fear the cruelty of outsiders? Never again have we explored. Never again has companionship been sought. Yet here you are.

title: The Magicks of Megas-Tu
line: And if one Earth ship can find us, friend Kirk, then so can others. That's what they fear.

title: The Magicks of Megas-Tu
line: We do not want to hurt you. We have never had to hurt anyone before. If there were some reason not to. Who will speak in defense of the Earth humans?

title: The Magicks of Megas-Tu
line: I will, Asmodeus. I am not of Earth.

title: The Magicks of Megas-Tu
line: Yes, you are different. The court will hear a defense.

title: The Magicks of Megas-Tu
line: I call Lucien as my first witness.

title: The Magicks of Megas-Tu
line: Lucien, you alone of all those here do not seem to fear or hate humans. Why?

title: The Magicks of Megas-Tu
line: They are like me, with questions to be answered, with minds that range outward, boundless. But every Megan is always alone in his sphere of knowledge. Humans are always together. They share. That is why I adopted your ship when I saw it arrive.

title: The Magicks of Megas-Tu
line: Thank you, Lucien. Next witness, please. Captain James T Kirk.

title: The Magicks of Megas-Tu
line: Tell the court, please, Captain Kirk. Would you say that since Salem, humans have changed?

title: The Magicks of Megas-Tu
line: I think we've been trying to, Spock. Humans have their faults, greed, envy, panicky fear. But in the centuries since the Salem witch trials we have learned. We try to understand and respect all life forms.

title: The Magicks of Megas-Tu
line: Indeed, Captain. Could you elaborate?

title: The Magicks of Megas-Tu
line: The records of the Enterprise are open for your inspection. All the history of Earth and the Federation is at your disposal. Look, look at General Order number One. No starship may interfere with the normal development of any alien life or society. Compare that with the Earth you once knew.

title: The Magicks of Megas-Tu
line: Enough! Here is your history. Here are your records. Citizens, you have heard, you have read. How do you vote? According to your records, your entry here was an accident unlikely to be duplicated. With that in mind, plus all you have said, it seems to us that Megas-Tu is safe. But Lucien must be punished. For his betrayal of his people, he shall be confined in limbo for all eternity, to live with only himself.

title: The Magicks of Megas-Tu
line: No. To isolate someone like Lucien, that's the same as sentencing him to death.

title: The Magicks of Megas-Tu
line: Do you realize who you defend? He has told you his name is Lucien. Would you defend him still if you knew he had another name too? The Rollicker, the Tempter, Lucifer.

title: The Magicks of Megas-Tu
line: We're not interested in legend. He's a living being, and intelligent life form. That's all we have to know about him. We will not join in harming him.

title: The Magicks of Megas-Tu
line: Submit, Captain. You haven't the power to fight us.

title: The Magicks of Megas-Tu
line: Captain, use the magic you know. Believe.

title: The Magicks of Megas-Tu
line: You cannot beat an entire planet, Captain Kirk. There is no way you can win.

title: The Magicks of Megas-Tu
line: I have to, or you'll become as bad as the Earthmen you fear. You're acting out of terror instead of out of thought or respect.

title: The Magicks of Megas-Tu
line: You were prepared to die for Lucien, a being who is alien to you?

title: The Magicks of Megas-Tu
line: As I was sure you would, friend Kirk. I told them their fears were groundless.

title: The Magicks of Megas-Tu
line: I don't understand.

title: The Magicks of Megas-Tu
line: This last was a test of your intentions, Captain. We had to be certain your records were no ruse. We have been tricked before much to our pain and sorrow.

title: The Magicks of Megas-Tu
line: I see. The Megans had to have proof that mankind had grown and learned wisdom since they last saw Earth. Your compassion was that proof, Captain.

title: The Magicks of Megas-Tu
line: If your people should visit us now, we shall do our best to welcome them. The banishment of fear will help us all.

title: The Magicks of Megas-Tu
line: A favorite old Earth custom of mine, Asmodeus. A toast to a new friendship.

title: The Magicks of Megas-Tu
line: All systems go, Captain. We're back to normal.

title: The Magicks of Megas-Tu
line: No more magic for us, Jim. It's all back there. You think Lucien really was the demon some men call Lucifer?

title: The Magicks of Megas-Tu
line: Does it really matter?

title: The Magicks of Megas-Tu
line: It just might, Captain. If he was, this would be the second time Lucifer was cast out, and thanks to you, the first time he was saved.

title: The Time Trap
line: Captain's log, stardate 52.2. We have just entered the Delta Triangle, a vast, uninhabited sector of our galaxy in which a high number of mysterious disappearances of starships have been recorded since ancient times. The Enterprise has been assigned the mission of surveying this area, and if possible, determining the cause of these disappearances.

title: The Time Trap
line: Situation, Mister Spock.

title: The Time Trap
line: Our sensors are in a state of chaos, Captain. They became unreliable when we entered the Triangle.

title: The Time Trap
line: Magnification ten on forward scanners, Mister Sulu.

title: The Time Trap
line: Magnification ten, sir.

title: The Time Trap
line: Klingon battle cruiser. Deflector shields up, Mister Sulu.

title: The Time Trap
line: Deflectors up, sir.

title: The Time Trap
line: Lieutenant Uhura, open a hailing frequency.

title: The Time Trap
line: Ready phasers.

title: The Time Trap
line: Phasers locked on target, sir.

title: The Time Trap
line: Fire.

title: The Time Trap
line: Firing phasers.

title: The Time Trap
line: Mister Spock, did you see what I think I just saw?

title: The Time Trap
line: Yes, Captain.

title: The Time Trap
line: Explanation?

title: The Time Trap
line: I can offer none at this time. However, the Klingon ship was not destroyed by our phaser fire. Its shields clearly deflected the phasers. Nor was its disappearance the type that would have been affected if it were using its cloaking device.

title: The Time Trap
line: Any sensor analysis on that wavering effect just before the ship disappeared?

title: The Time Trap
line: The sensors are still not registering normally, sir. But I would venture the theory it has something to do with the many ship disappearances in this area.

title: The Time Trap
line: A natural phenomenon. But what? Duty personnel on Yellow Alert. Visual scan three hundred and sixty degrees, Mister Sulu.

title: The Time Trap
line: Scanning three hundred and sixty degrees, sir.

title: The Time Trap
line: Mousetrapped. If the first ship doesn't succeed in blasting us out of existence, they have two backup ships to do the job.

title: The Time Trap
line: Tactically well planned. When the Federation investigates, we'll be recorded as just another mysterious starship disappearance.

title: The Time Trap
line: Captain, we are receiving a class two signal from the lead Klingon vessel.

title: The Time Trap
line: One moment, Lieutenant. Mister Sulu, on my command, I want you to turn the Enterprise and head for the exact co-ordinates where the Klingon ship disappeared. Warp eight.

title: The Time Trap
line: Yes, sir.

title: The Time Trap
line: Put the signal on the main viewing screen, Lieutenant, and pipe the entire exchange back to Starfleet Command.

title: The Time Trap
line: It will take three weeks to reach the nearest starbase, sir.

title: The Time Trap
line: Nonetheless, let's have it on the record.

title: The Time Trap
line: Aye, sir. Signal in.

title: The Time Trap
line: You have been identified as the starship Enterprise. Captain James T Kirk last known to be in command.

title: The Time Trap
line: Your information is correct. This is Captain Kirk.

title: The Time Trap
line: I am Commander Kuri of the Klingon Imperial Fleet. We have witnessed the destruction of our sister ship, the Klothos, and hold you responsible. Surrender immediately or we will destroy you.

title: The Time Trap
line: We did not destroy the Klothos, and you are well aware of it, Commander.

title: The Time Trap
line: Surely you don't expect me to believe she just vanished?

title: The Time Trap
line: You may believe what you like, Commander. We were fired upon first and returned fire. The Klothos deflectors turned aside our phaser fire and then disappeared. I don't know why. But we are in the Delta Triangle.

title: The Time Trap
line: I do not accept this.

title: The Time Trap
line: Frankly, Commander, what you accept is of little importance to me. Enterprise out. Now, Mister Sulu.

title: The Time Trap
line: What fools! Thinking they can escape. Accelerate to maximum and prepare to open fire.

title: The Time Trap
line: Sir, aren't we going to defend ourselves?

title: The Time Trap
line: Your deflector shields are doing that for us, Mister Scott.

title: The Time Trap
line: But to just turn and run, sir.

title: The Time Trap
line: We'll fight if we have to. Sulu, are we headed for the exact co-ordinates where the Klothos disappeared?

title: The Time Trap
line: Dead on, sir. We'll be there in ten seconds.

title: The Time Trap
line: Captain, our deflector shields have just gone out.

title: The Time Trap
line: Sir, the instruments. They've gone haywire. I can't orient myself. Everything is

title: The Time Trap
line: Subspace radio channels are dead, sir.

title: The Time Trap
line: Where did they go?

title: The Time Trap
line: Captain, I've lost all co-ordination. Dizzy.

title: The Time Trap
line: Sir, we seem to be suffering from some form of vertigo.

title: The Time Trap
line: Sulu, are we still on the same co-ordinates?

title: The Time Trap
line: I can't tell, sir. Vision won't focus.

title: The Time Trap
line: Captain, on the viewscreen.

title: The Time Trap
line: It's like a vast Sargasso Sea. A graveyard of ships from every civilisation imaginable.

title: The Time Trap
line: Where are we, sir?

title: The Time Trap
line: At another place in time, I think. If we check closely, I believe we'll find many of those ships are the ones designated as lost in the Delta Triangle.

title: The Time Trap
line: An alternate universe?

title: The Time Trap
line: Something corresponding to that. The records say every ship lost here vanished without a trace. Most logged communication loss and disorientation just before disappearance. My guess was they entered a window to some other continuum. Comments, Spock?

title: The Time Trap
line: Your logic is excellent, Captain. There is a random factor to the ship disappearances. Perhaps the touching of the two time continuums is erratic. In any event, the window stayed open long enough for us to follow the Klothos in.

title: The Time Trap
line: Aye, and where is that tricky devil?

title: The Time Trap
line: I've been scanning for her, but there are so many ships here it's hard to pick up a specific trace.

title: The Time Trap
line: Stay on it, Mister Sulu.

title: The Time Trap
line: Aye, sir.

title: The Time Trap
line: There are ships here I've only seen crude drawings of, pictures in museums.

title: The Time Trap
line: Sensor scans give a rough approximation of the age of the metal in the hulls, Captain. Some of them have been here for centuries.

title: The Time Trap
line: Captain, there's the old Bonaventure. She was the first ship to have warp drive installled. She vanished without a trace on her third voyage.

title: The Time Trap
line: The crew's descendants may still be living, Captain.

title: The Time Trap
line: Their descendants?

title: The Time Trap
line: Yes. I am picking up life and energy readings from the cluster of ships ahead of us.

title: The Time Trap
line: Scanners indicate the Enterprise shields are totally depleted, sir.

title: The Time Trap
line: Good. All hands to battle stations. Prepare to open fire on the Enterprise immediately.

title: The Time Trap
line: Captain, the Klothos, dead ahead.

title: The Time Trap
line: Sound Red Alert. Phasers lock on target.

title: The Time Trap
line: Aye, sir. Phasers locked on.

title: The Time Trap
line: Fire!

title: The Time Trap
line: Sir, our weaponry is frozen.

title: The Time Trap
line: Fire.

title: The Time Trap
line: Firing phasers.

title: The Time Trap
line: Report, sir.

title: The Time Trap
line: No response, sir. There's no indication of damage. All instruments register normal.

title: The Time Trap
line: Captain's log, supplemental. First Officer Spock recording. We appear to be in an alternate universe. Position, undetermined. Captain Kirk has been transported from the ship by an unknown power. His present location also is undetermined.

title: The Time Trap
line: That will not be needed here, Commander Kor.

title: The Time Trap
line: Welcome to Elysia. Devna, Interpreter of Laws. DEVNA Gentlemen, you now stand before the Ruling Council. Elysia is comprised of representatives of a hundred and twenty three races. Our existence dates back over one thousand years. During this time, these diverse races, many of whom were enemies on the outside, have learned to live together because they must. As a result, any act of violence is strictly forbidden, and will be dealt with swiftly and with utmost severity. Questions?

title: The Time Trap
line: Are we in an alternate universe?

title: The Time Trap
line: It is more aptly described as a pocket in the garment of time.

title: The Time Trap
line: How did you freeze my weaponry?

title: The Time Trap
line: We have among us many individuals gifted with psionic powers, peace being our single goal. You were attempting to break that peace.

title: The Time Trap
line: Pronounce the law.

title: The Time Trap
line: Under our law, you as ship captains are responsible for the behavior of your crews. Should a crew member, with or without your knowledge, engage in any form of violence whatsoever, you will suffer the ultimate penalty. Total immobilization of your ship for a century.

title: The Time Trap
line: A century? We'd all be dead by the end of it.

title: The Time Trap
line: No, Commander Kor. This small universe of ours is a curios trap. Time passes here, but very slowly. A century means nothing to us. Our Council appears young. Yet all are centuries old.

title: The Time Trap
line: Your life here must be almost perfect, if you haven't wanted to leave.

title: The Time Trap
line: All of us have wanted to leave at some time, Captain Kirk. But we have made the best possible world here, because we have found there is no escape from it.

title: The Time Trap
line: We are getting out.

title: The Time Trap
line: Then we'd better do it pretty quick, Captain.

title: The Time Trap
line: If we find an answer, it will still take time.

title: The Time Trap
line: That's just what we haven't got.

title: The Time Trap
line: What's wrong, Scotty?

title: The Time Trap
line: It's our dilithium crystals, sir. They're deteriorating rapidly.

title: The Time Trap
line: But how?

title: The Time Trap
line: I don't know, sir. Maybe because of the time warp we went through. But we've only four days at the most before power goes.

title: The Time Trap
line: Got any miracles in your computer, Spock?

title: The Time Trap
line: Impossible to predict, Captain.

title: The Time Trap
line: I don't want a prediction. You will start work immediately, around the clock, nonstop, until you arrive at a formula that gets us out of here.

title: The Time Trap
line: These computations are useless. Get out of here and don't come back until you have a plan that works.

title: The Time Trap
line: Yes, sir.

title: The Time Trap
line: What do you see beyond your eyes, Magen?

title: The Time Trap
line: Two new ships. In each, beings labor to solve the riddle. The riddle of the time trap escape. Escape.

title: The Time Trap
line: Gently, good Magen. Return to us now.

title: The Time Trap
line: It is impossible.

title: The Time Trap
line: They must try, Xerius. They all must try before they accept.

title: The Time Trap
line: This is the best you could come up with, Mister Spock?

title: The Time Trap
line: Yes, sir.

title: The Time Trap
line: Have you covered every possibility? Every factor?

title: The Time Trap
line: Several times, Captain. I do not wish to surrender hope, but the facts remain unchangeable.

title: The Time Trap
line: He isn't giving up. If they can do it, why can't we?

title: The Time Trap
line: I do not believe they can, sir. High rank probability. Their S2 graf unit, which is roughly the equivalent of our warp drive, began giving off depleted energy readings. Kor decided to try to bluff it through.

title: The Time Trap
line: Jeopardizing his crew and his ship unnecessarily?

title: The Time Trap
line: All power has been diverted to the engines, sir. We're picking up speed.

title: The Time Trap
line: You were right, Spock. But I almost wish they'd made it.

title: The Time Trap
line: Their attempt has given me an idea as to how we may be able to break through the time barrier.

title: The Time Trap
line: Mister Spock has come up with a formula which may just get us out of here.

title: The Time Trap
line: But this involves combining our ship with the Klothos.

title: The Time Trap
line: That is correct.

title: The Time Trap
line: You mean you want us to co-operate with those

title: The Time Trap
line: If we want to get out of here, it's our only choice.

title: The Time Trap
line: It's a complicated navigation problem, trying to guide two such disparate ships.

title: The Time Trap
line: Considering we only have two days left before our supply of dilithium crystals is exhausted, I say we go with this plan.

title: The Time Trap
line: I agree, sir.

title: The Time Trap
line: Good. I'll contact Kor right away.

title: The Time Trap
line: What is it?

title: The Time Trap
line: These new ones. Now they plan to combine the two ships and try again. Can you not stop them, Xerius?

title: The Time Trap
line: It is not against our laws to try to escape.

title: The Time Trap
line: But they may kill themselves in these mad attempts.

title: The Time Trap
line: So long as they do not break our laws, we must not impede them.

title: The Time Trap
line: Even if they die?

title: The Time Trap
line: It is their choice.

title: The Time Trap
line: Then it's settled. Our science teams will get to work right away conjoining our warp and navigation systems so we will function as a single ship. Exchange of personnel and computer hookup to start as soon as we are beamed back to our ship.

title: The Time Trap
line: Agreed.

title: The Time Trap
line: Mister Spock?

title: The Time Trap
line: I cannot tell you how impressed I am by your splendid spirit of co-operation.

title: The Time Trap
line: Mister Spock!

title: The Time Trap
line: Forgive me, Commander. I was overcome by the moment. Goodbye.

title: The Time Trap
line: Goodbye, Mister Spock. Captain Kirk.

title: The Time Trap
line: The stories of his being half human must be true.

title: The Time Trap
line: Perhaps the time continuum affected his mind.

title: The Time Trap
line: I wonder if we all haven't become affected.

title: The Time Trap
line: Explain yourself.

title: The Time Trap
line: Your willingness to work with your old enemy, Kirk. It is not like you, Commander. What do you really have in mind?

title: The Time Trap
line: You do know me, Kaz. Very well, what would you think if the Enterprise suddenly disintegrated after our dual ship had pierced the time continuum?

title: The Time Trap
line: I would think my commander had maneuverd brilliantly.

title: The Time Trap
line: And it can be arranged, practically speaking?

title: The Time Trap
line: It implies a rather high risk factor, given the time involved and Kirk's highly suspicious nature. But I believe it can be arranged.

title: The Time Trap
line: Very good, Kaz. I will leave it to you to attend to the details of the Enterprise's destruction.

title: The Time Trap
line: Captain's log, stardate 5267.6. We are in the final stages preparatory to making our escape from Elysia.

title: The Time Trap
line: We must make our escape by tomorrow or our dilithium crystals will be too depleted, and we will be trapped here forever.

title: The Time Trap
line: Beg your pardon, sir.

title: The Time Trap
line: What is it, Gabler.

title: The Time Trap
line: Bell and I are the relief guard for the dilithium vault. We arrived a few minutes late and found them poking around.

title: The Time Trap
line: We were lost.

title: The Time Trap
line: Lost, my foot. It's clearly posted as a restricted area. You knew you weren't supposed to be there.

title: The Time Trap
line: Gentlemen, I'm sure there has been a mistake. Where are you supposed to be working?

title: The Time Trap
line: Engineering, deck five.

title: The Time Trap
line: Captain, allow me to escort this young man to his work area.

title: The Time Trap
line: Very well, Mister Spock.

title: The Time Trap
line: Return to your post and don't leave it until you've been relieved.

title: The Time Trap
line: Aye, sir.

title: The Time Trap
line: Jim, I'm worried about Spock. He's just not acting normal.

title: The Time Trap
line: He's under a lot of pressure, Bones.

title: The Time Trap
line: I know that. But I've never known Spock to act like a pal under any circumstances, least of all toward Klingons.

title: The Time Trap
line: That's true.

title: The Time Trap
line: And if he's coming apart, Jim, we're in serious trouble. Getting out of here hinges on his computations.

title: The Time Trap
line: I'll talk to him, Bones. It's all I can do.

title: The Time Trap
line: Everything seems to be in order. But then you're the only person who can really be sure. Isn't that right, Spock?

title: The Time Trap
line: Yes, Captain. Why do you ask?

title: The Time Trap
line: Your recent behavior. Is something wrong?

title: The Time Trap
line: I believe there is, Captain. But not within me. I sensed something strange about the Klingons when we were aboard the Klothos. They were too agreeable, too willing to co-operate.

title: The Time Trap
line: Why is that unusual? They want to get out of here as much as we do.

title: The Time Trap
line: Had I not touched them, I would have agreed with you, Captain. But even though contact was necessarily limited and their minds were suspicious, I picked up some indication they are planning to sabotage the Enterprise.

title: The Time Trap
line: Sabotage! How? When?

title: The Time Trap
line: I cannot say. The Klingon found near the dilithium vault knew nothing specific. But there is some kind of sabotage in the offing.

title: The Time Trap
line: They need us to get through the time barrier, if they're to get through at all. Security, this is Captain Kirk. I want all security teams on duty around the clock. Watch every Klingon who sets foot aboard this ship. I don't want one of them to make a move we don't know about.

title: The Time Trap
line: You have the device, Kaz?

title: The Time Trap
line: By my calculations, the capsule will be triggered the exact moment our dual ship reaches warp eight. Approximately three minutes after the time barrier is pierced and we have disengaged, the Enterprise will disintegrate.

title: The Time Trap
line: Excellent! Kali, you know what to do. Tonight they entertain us, but the gift they will receive in return will be their destruction.

title: The Time Trap
line: Beautifully done.

title: The Time Trap
line: I thank you, Captain. You have seen the dance of Orion women before?

title: The Time Trap
line: Many times.

title: The Time Trap
line: I wish

title: The Time Trap
line: Yes?

title: The Time Trap
line: I wish I could return through the time barrier and see Orion again.

title: The Time Trap
line: You could go. We're willing to take passengers.

title: The Time Trap
line: No. You see, we have all seen the futility of attempting to escape. Once each of us dreamed of breaking free. Then we came to understand it could not be done, and we accepted our life here.

title: The Time Trap
line: We believe it can be done.

title: The Time Trap
line: Then I shall not interfere with your dream, Captain.

title: The Time Trap
line: Get away from here, human. This is my woman.

title: The Time Trap
line: Now just a minute. All I did was ask her to dance. She didn't have to say yes.

title: The Time Trap
line: Bones!

title: The Time Trap
line: Stop!

title: The Time Trap
line: Ship captains and these two will come to the Council Chamber now to face charges.

title: The Time Trap
line: You know any form of violence is forbidden here. Your man began the fight and attempted to kill. I propose we freeze the Klothos and its crew for a star century.

title: The Time Trap
line: May I speak?

title: The Time Trap
line: You may.

title: The Time Trap
line: Captain Kor and I were preparing to attempt an escape from here tomorrow. If you hibernate the Klothos, you will not only be punishing them but us. We cannot leave as a single ship. I urge you to permit our dual ship to depart tomorrow as scheduled.

title: The Time Trap
line: Getting back to your own time continuum is that important to you?

title: The Time Trap
line: Yes.

title: The Time Trap
line: You will fail.

title: The Time Trap
line: We must try, Xerius. Elysia is, in many respects, a perfect society. But with all its virtues, it is not home. And home, with all its faults, is where we prefer to be.

title: The Time Trap
line: You would take these renegades with you?

title: The Time Trap
line: We need them.

title: The Time Trap
line: Very well. I release Captain Kor into your custody. Good luck to you, Captain Kirk. You will be needing it.

title: The Time Trap
line: Ready to accelerate to warp six.

title: The Time Trap
line: Ready, sir.

title: The Time Trap
line: Three, two, one. Accelerate.

title: The Time Trap
line: No! The Klingons have hidden an explosive aboard the Enterprise. She will be destroyed.

title: The Time Trap
line: Enterprise, this is Xerius! Come in, Enterprise.

title: The Time Trap
line: Warp seven, Captain.

title: The Time Trap
line: Sir, Xerius is calling us. He says it's urgent.

title: The Time Trap
line: On audio, Lieutenant.

title: The Time Trap
line: Captain Kirk! The Klingons have placed and explosive in your computer room. Magen says it is located in the warp control panel.

title: The Time Trap
line: It will go off when you reach warp eight.

title: The Time Trap
line: Spock. Scotty.

title: The Time Trap
line: Approaching warp eight, sir.

title: The Time Trap
line: The barrier.

title: The Time Trap
line: There it is, sir.

title: The Time Trap
line: Captain Kirk, I'm picking up a radio transmission Captain Kor intended for his home base. He took full credit for our escape from Elysia.

title: The Time Trap
line: Why, that scoundrel.

title: The Time Trap
line: It doesn't matter, Bones.

title: The Time Trap
line: It doesn't?

title: The Time Trap
line: That's what matters.

title: The Slaver Weapon
line: These stasis boxes are the most remarkable thing the Slavers ever produced. Time stands still inside a stasis box. A billion years means nothing in there. What is it, Lieutenant?

title: The Slaver Weapon
line: I've studied the history of the Slaver Empire, but it's sketchy. We know they were masters of all the intelligent beings in this galaxy a billion years ago, until one race revolted. Are the stasis boxes the only source of information we have?

title: The Slaver Weapon
line: The Slavers and all their subjects were exterminated in the war that followed. Intelligent life had to evolve all over again. The stasis boxes are the only remnant of those lost civilisations.

title: The Slaver Weapon
line: Why is it glowing like that?

title: The Slaver Weapon
line: Mister Sulu, what is our position?

title: The Slaver Weapon
line: Passing Beta Lyrae, sir. One forty two degrees north east of galactic plane.

title: The Slaver Weapon
line: Most peculiar. This indicates there is another stasis box circling Beta Lyrae.

title: The Slaver Weapon
line: Another one?

title: The Slaver Weapon
line: It would be most illogical that a stasis box would remain here undiskovered for so long. Beta Lyrae is one of the rare spectacles of the galaxy. Almost every ship that passes stops to see it.

title: The Slaver Weapon
line: Maybe no one else was carrying a stasis box detector.

title: The Slaver Weapon
line: Possible. The only known stasis box detector is another stasis box. Still. Mister Sulu.

title: The Slaver Weapon
line: Yes, sir.

title: The Slaver Weapon
line: Bring us about. We'll investigate the Beta Lyrae system.

title: The Slaver Weapon
line: Aye, aye, sir.

title: The Slaver Weapon
line: Stasis boxes and their contents are the only remnant of a species which ruled most of this galaxy a billion years ago. Their effect on science has been incalculable. In one was found a flying belt which was the key to the artificial gravity field used by starships. Another box contained a disrupter bomb with the pin pulled. As a result, all stasis boxes are now under the jurisdiction of Starfleet, and only certain key specialists handle them. The boxes are rare, potentially dangerous, and we seem to have found a second one.

title: The Slaver Weapon
line: I never did like these little ice-bound worlds.

title: The Slaver Weapon
line: We are not tourists here, Lieutenant.

title: The Slaver Weapon
line: Mister Spock, if it takes a stasis box to find another stasis box, how did anyone ever find the first one?

title: The Slaver Weapon
line: As with a number of diskoveries, purely by accident, Lieutenant. The other box seems to be almost under us, perhaps thirty meters below the ice.

title: The Slaver Weapon
line: We won't have any trouble digging for it. In this low pressure, the ice should boil as soon as the phasers melt it.

title: The Slaver Weapon
line: I must take full responsibility for this event. Instead of being warned by the highly unlikely coincidence of a second stasis box, I allowed it's possible value to influence my judgment. The Kzinti now possess our stasis box. Its contents will determine how much damage my error has done the Federation and its people.

title: The Slaver Weapon
line: Where are we?

title: The Slaver Weapon
line: A Kzinti spacecraft.

title: The Slaver Weapon
line: That isn't good. Kzinti aren't supposed to have phasers, are they?

title: The Slaver Weapon
line: The Treaty of Sirius does not permit them any weapons at all, beyond police vessels. Obviously, the treaty has been broken.

title: The Slaver Weapon
line: A police web. We won't be able to move unless we can turn it off somehow.

title: The Slaver Weapon
line: The lean, be-draggles one is a reader of minds.

title: The Slaver Weapon
line: I've heard all Kzinti telepaths are unhappy neurotics. He fits the description.

title: The Slaver Weapon
line: There is no sure way to guard our thoughts from him. Mister Sulu, he is not likely to deal with me or Lieutenant Uhura. She and I are inferior beings to them. But the Kzinti are meat eaters. If you sense him reading your mind, think of eating a raw vegetable.

title: The Slaver Weapon
line: Yes, sir. Maybe I can goad them into revealing their purpose.

title: The Slaver Weapon
line: Lieutenant Uhura. This may be crucial. In the presence of the Kzinti, do not say anything, do not do anything startling. Try to look harmless.

title: The Slaver Weapon
line: Any special reason?

title: The Slaver Weapon
line: Are you forgetting Kzinti females are dumb animals? In an emergency the Kzinti may forget a human female is an intelligent creature.

title: The Slaver Weapon
line: Thanks. Thanks a lot.

title: The Slaver Weapon
line: Lieutenant, I value your intelligence, but we may be able to seize an opportunity to escape if the Kzinti believe you have none.

title: The Slaver Weapon
line: Yes, sir. CHUFT-

title: The Slaver Weapon
line: Identify yourself.

title: The Slaver Weapon
line: Lieutenant Sulu of the Starfleet vessel Enterprise. This is First Officer Spock. CHUFT-

title: The Slaver Weapon
line: You're a Vulcan. I feel no pressing need to talk to an eater of roots and leaves. Humans at least are omnivorous. I am Chuft-Captain. You are prisoners aboard the privateer Traitor's Claw, a stolen police vessel.

title: The Slaver Weapon
line: Stealing must be a habit with you. This ship, two stasis boxes. CHUFT-

title: The Slaver Weapon
line: Kzinti archeologists found both boxes, but the one we managed to keep was empty. It served us well as bait to draw you here, but the Slavers had weapons that could devastate a galaxy. There could be one in that box.

title: The Slaver Weapon
line: The Kzinti fought four wars with humankind and lost all of them. The last one was two hundred years ago, and you haven't learned a thing since. CHUFT-

title: The Slaver Weapon
line: Guard your speech. None of my crew has yet tasted human meat as our ancestors did. We would welcome the opportunity. Always you have had superior equipment. We seek a weapon that will defeat you at last.

title: The Slaver Weapon
line: Then you're really working for the Kzinti government. CHUFT-

title: The Slaver Weapon
line: The records will show the Traitor's Claw is a stolen police ship. If we are captured, the Highest of Kzin will repudiate us. But if we succeed, you are meat for our tables.

title: The Slaver Weapon
line: Could that be a picture of a Slaver?

title: The Slaver Weapon
line: If so, it is the first ever diskovered. An important historical find.

title: The Slaver Weapon
line: It looks like fresh meat. Over a billion years in that box, and it looks fresh. CHUFT-

title: The Slaver Weapon
line: Nothing like this has ever been found. We are the only ones who have it. Look at it, human. This weapon may well mean the end of mankind. First Officer's log, supplemental. The Kzinti now possess a weapon potentially deadly to the entire galaxy. The extent of its power remains to be seen.

title: The Slaver Weapon
line: Have the humans moved to the surface and be sure they're secured in the police web. We will use them to test the weapon.

title: The Slaver Weapon
line: Yes, Chuft-Captain. CHUFT-

title: The Slaver Weapon
line: You have observed the aliens. Can you read their minds?

title: The Slaver Weapon
line: I can read Sulu with difficulty, Chuft-Captain. The other human is only a female. The third is a pacifistic herbivore. Surely you would not force me to delve such minds? CHUFT-

title: The Slaver Weapon
line: If it is necessary. I realize the time you need to recover from each effort.

title: The Slaver Weapon
line: Chuft-Captain, we have finished testing the meat that was in the stasis box. It is protoplasmic and poisonous. CHUFT-

title: The Slaver Weapon
line: What of the picture?

title: The Slaver Weapon
line: The human, Sulu, believes it to be a Slaver. CHUFT-

title: The Slaver Weapon
line: So do I. It would have made a worthy enemy.

title: The Slaver Weapon
line: Perhaps the toggle. CHUFT-

title: The Slaver Weapon
line: Telepath! Am I not affecting him at all? Is it the life support belt interfering?

title: The Slaver Weapon
line: No, Chuft-Captain. He hears a faint whine, but he feels no ill effects. There is a vibration in the metal of his belt. Chuft-Captain, he is too alien. He makes me taste yellow root munched between flat teeth. CHUFT-

title: The Slaver Weapon
line: Be glad if you need not read the Vulcan's mind. It may be a communications device, or a sonic stunner designed to affect members of a race now dead. CHUFT-

title: The Slaver Weapon
line: A good serviceable telescope. They built well, these Slavers.

title: The Slaver Weapon
line: It is of no use to us. We already have small telescopes. CHUFT-

title: The Slaver Weapon
line: I give you credit, human. You are not afraid to die.

title: The Slaver Weapon
line: Merely a laser. The Federation has had a more effective model for over one hundred years.

title: The Slaver Weapon
line: Telepath's suit has ruptured. CHUFT-

title: The Slaver Weapon
line: Never mind that. The female is escaping!

title: The Slaver Weapon
line: What of it? CHUFT-

title: The Slaver Weapon
line: Fool! Human females are intelligent.

title: The Slaver Weapon
line: Telepath's suit lost considerable pressure. We reached the ship in time to save him. CHUFT-

title: The Slaver Weapon
line: Good. We will need him later. What is this?

title: The Slaver Weapon
line: Perhaps a personal rocket motor. One could place one's foot on the pedals and balance. It appears to be transportation, not a weapon.

title: The Slaver Weapon
line: Nice try.

title: The Slaver Weapon
line: I'm slowing down. I used to run the hundred in record time. How long was I out? Did I miss much?

title: The Slaver Weapon
line: Not much. A lot of good they'll get out of that rocket setting.

title: The Slaver Weapon
line: We are fortunate none of the settings so far have been superior to the technology now available to the Federation.

title: The Slaver Weapon
line: Uh oh. CHUFT-

title: The Slaver Weapon
line: No gun sight. No obvious was to aim it.

title: The Slaver Weapon
line: Mister Spock, I can move.

title: The Slaver Weapon
line: So can I. The police web is off.

title: The Slaver Weapon
line: The fifth setting seems to be an energy absorber. Fascinating. I had no idea the Slavers had such things.

title: The Slaver Weapon
line: Mister Spock, we

title: The Slaver Weapon
line: Yes. When I give the word, make for the shuttle. Remember to zigzag. Ready? Go.

title: The Slaver Weapon
line: Chuft-Captain, what happened? CHUFT-

title: The Slaver Weapon
line: I would rather not diskuss it. Help me into the ship.

title: The Slaver Weapon
line: Mister Spock! I thought it was one of the aliens.

title: The Slaver Weapon
line: I have the weapon.

title: The Slaver Weapon
line: They've got Uhura, and subspace radio. They can call for help from the Kzin planet if they think the weapon's worth it.

title: The Slaver Weapon
line: No, they cannot. Or rather, will not.

title: The Slaver Weapon
line: Why?

title: The Slaver Weapon
line: Because I kicked Chuft-Captain. Consider. Chuft-Captain has been attacked by an herbivorous pacifist, an eater of leaves and roots. One who traditionally does not fight. And the ultimate insult, I left him alive. Chuft-Captain's honor is at stake. He must seek personal revenge before he can call for help.

title: The Slaver Weapon
line: That gives us some time. You did plan it that way?

title: The Slaver Weapon
line: Of course.

title: The Slaver Weapon
line: As long as you stay free, the Kzinti can't or won't do anything. But they could use Lieutenant Uhura as a bribe.

title: The Slaver Weapon
line: Agreed. However, to this point, we have not seen anything more powerful than equipment Starfleet already has.

title: The Slaver Weapon
line: Yes. But I have a feeling, Mister Spock. This weapon must have belonged to a spy, an espionage agent.

title: The Slaver Weapon
line: I acknowledge your expertise in the field of weapons, Mister Sulu, but I do not see how you can determine probable ownership.

title: The Slaver Weapon
line: Well, here, look at it. All these settings. We don't know a common Slaver soldier couldn't handle them, but as a weapon, only the laser is effective. The others aren't necessary for the line soldier's one purpose, to destroy the enemy.

title: The Slaver Weapon
line: Assuming it's a spy weapon then, the Slavers would have wanted to keep it a secret weapon. If so, it is logical to assume it has a self-destruct setting too.

title: The Slaver Weapon
line: But we've seen all the phases.

title: The Slaver Weapon
line: Perhaps not. There is the null setting. It seems to do nothing. But why should it be there? It does not correspond to a safety lock.

title: The Slaver Weapon
line: It may be the key to another setting.

title: The Slaver Weapon
line: This is the Traitor's Claw calling Mister Sulu.

title: The Slaver Weapon
line: We have the female prisoner. Will you bargain, or must we take harsh action? It will not be pleasant for her. I repeat. We have the female prisoner as hostage. You have something we want. We will trade her life for the Slaver weapon.

title: The Slaver Weapon
line: Answer him, Lieutenant.

title: The Slaver Weapon
line: Lieutenant Sulu here. What about Mister Spock? CHUFT-

title: The Slaver Weapon
line: He must surrender. I will offer him single combat.

title: The Slaver Weapon
line: Not interested.

title: The Slaver Weapon
line: I am as the Vulcan left me, with two ribs broken. I have not set them nor bandaged myself. He may conceivably kill me.

title: The Slaver Weapon
line: Kzinti ribs have some vertical bracing. But I kicked him over one heart. I compute the odds of my defeating Chuft-Captain in combat at sixteen to one against.

title: The Slaver Weapon
line: Offer refused.

title: The Slaver Weapon
line: They think very little of you.

title: The Slaver Weapon
line: Wrong. They don't think much of you.

title: The Slaver Weapon
line: A self-destruct mechanism would not have a gun sight.

title: The Slaver Weapon
line: No. Let's see what this does do.

title: The Slaver Weapon
line: We can't give them that!

title: The Slaver Weapon
line: Fascinating. No world in the Federation has produced anything so powerful. Almost beyond theoretical limits. Total conversion of matter to energy at a distance.

title: The Slaver Weapon
line: If the Kzinti had that, the whole galaxy would be their dinner table.

title: The Slaver Weapon
line: Hit the dirt!

title: The Slaver Weapon
line: What would this be?

title: The Slaver Weapon
line: I have no idea. It is generating power.

title: The Slaver Weapon
line: There is a grid. It may be another communications device. But that seems redundant.

title: The Slaver Weapon
line: It has the Kzinti frightened.

title: The Slaver Weapon
line: The Kzinti have legends of weapons haunted by their owners.

title: The Slaver Weapon
line: Could it be a voice-activated mechanism?

title: The Slaver Weapon
line: No, it appears to be conversing with them. A reasoning computer that small? CHUFT-

title: The Slaver Weapon
line: How long has it been since you were turned off?

title: The Slaver Weapon
line: I do not know. When I am off, I have no sense of passing time. CHUFT-

title: The Slaver Weapon
line: What is the last thing you remember?

title: The Slaver Weapon
line: We were on a mission. I may not tell you of it unless you know certain code words.

title: The Slaver Weapon
line: If you could describe the positions of the stars in your sector, we would know how much time has passed since then.

title: The Slaver Weapon
line: Without certain code words, I may not describe our location. CHUFT-

title: The Slaver Weapon
line: One of the settings on this weapon was a total conversion beam. We saw it. Tell us how to find it.

title: The Slaver Weapon
line: Twist me widdershins until you reach the null position. Then

title: The Slaver Weapon
line: They've got it.

title: The Slaver Weapon
line: There must be something we can do.

title: The Slaver Weapon
line: Most peculiar.

title: The Slaver Weapon
line: That was not the total conversion beam setting.

title: The Slaver Weapon
line: Like others, this form seems to possess no gun sight.

title: The Slaver Weapon
line: It may be a broad-beam weapon, for use only from orbit. We saw its power. I suggest you fire at a very distant target. CHUFT-

title: The Slaver Weapon
line: Very well.

title: The Slaver Weapon
line: We can't let them have that weapon.

title: The Slaver Weapon
line: They are not about to get it, Lieutenant.

title: The Slaver Weapon
line: Why not?

title: The Slaver Weapon
line: Assume you are a Slaver war computer. You've been turned off. You do not know for how long, but when you were turned off, there was a war on. Now you are awakened by aliens you never saw before. They do not know any of the military passwords. They ask you so many questions it is obvious they know little about you. Your owner is nowhere about. What would you think?

title: The Slaver Weapon
line: I'd think I'd been captured by the enemy. Or an enemy, at least.

title: The Slaver Weapon
line: And when they asked you how to find your most powerful weapon setting, what would you give them?

title: The Slaver Weapon
line: Activate life support belts.

title: The Slaver Weapon
line: A disrupter field.

title: The Slaver Weapon
line: Yes. Another conventional weapon. It appears the total conversion beam was the only thing the Slavers had that we do not.

title: The Slaver Weapon
line: No sign of the weapon, of course. It would have looked nice in some museum.

title: The Slaver Weapon
line: It never would have reached the museum, Lieutenant. There was too much power in that one setting. If not the Kzinti, the Klingons or some other species would have tried to possess it.

title: The Slaver Weapon
line: Strange, how the past sometimes breaks through into the present. That ancient war could have sparked a new war between man and Kzinti.

title: The Slaver Weapon
line: Didn't you say the Kzinti have legends of weapons haunted by their dead owners?

title: The Slaver Weapon
line: Yes, an ancient superstition.

title: The Slaver Weapon
line: At this rate, they'll never get over those old superstitions.

title: The Ambergris Element
line: Captain's log, stardate 5499.9. We are orbiting the planet Argo. Argo was once a land planet, but it's surface is now almost completely covered by water. The change was caused by violent seismic disturbances. Our mission is to study the effects which the quakes and other phenomena had on its surface. This knowledge may save millions of lives on a Federation planet identical to Argo which will soon be undergoing similar transformation.

title: The Ambergris Element
line: This is the largest land mass on the planet, isn't it, Spock?

title: The Ambergris Element
line: Yes, Captain. The others are mere outcroppings. They suggest the peaks of submerged mountains.

title: The Ambergris Element
line: I suggest that we get these seawater and algae specimens. They're the least of the lot.

title: The Ambergris Element
line: For once I agree with you, Doctor. The more informative specimens will come from the sea bottom.

title: The Ambergris Element
line: Lieutenant Clayton, open the hatch and let our two scientists here get on with their business.

title: The Ambergris Element
line: Aye, sir.

title: The Ambergris Element
line: What's that?

title: The Ambergris Element
line: Phasers on stun, Mister Spock.

title: The Ambergris Element
line: Firing, Captain.

title: The Ambergris Element
line: What the devil was that thing?

title: The Ambergris Element
line: Apparently a life form which previous surveys have not recorded.

title: The Ambergris Element
line: Let's get a closer look at it before the phaser stun wears off. Submerge, Lieutenant.

title: The Ambergris Element
line: Aye, sir.

title: The Ambergris Element
line: Dual respiratory system. Lungs and gills.

title: The Ambergris Element
line: Its skeleton is similar to that of a Denebian whale, Captain.

title: The Ambergris Element
line: It's regaining consciousness. Surface, Mister Clayton.

title: The Ambergris Element
line: Aye, sir.

title: The Ambergris Element
line: Spock, prepare to fire phasers.

title: The Ambergris Element
line: Phasers do not respond, Captain. We must have sustained damage to the power pack when the creature struck us.

title: The Ambergris Element
line: Kirk to Enterprise. Emergency.

title: The Ambergris Element
line: Enterprise. What is it, sir.

title: The Ambergris Element
line: We're under attack. Beam us aboard, Scotty.

title: The Ambergris Element
line: We've lost contact, Captain.

title: The Ambergris Element
line: Repeat, we've lost contact. Come in, Captain. Come in. Ship's log, stardate 5504.2. Lieutenant Commander Scott in command. Captain Kirk and First Officer Spock have been missing for almost five days. Search parties can find no trace of them or the aqua-shuttle. Doctor McCoy and I are continuing the search at a greater distance from the attack point.

title: The Ambergris Element
line: There's nothing. There's just nothing.

title: The Ambergris Element
line: I see some rocks. They're just above sea level, about two miles away. There's something on them.

title: The Ambergris Element
line: Maybe they're still alive.

title: The Ambergris Element
line: Their bodies are functioning. Metabolism, heart. Everything but the lungs.

title: The Ambergris Element
line: Can't breathe. Suffocating. Help. Can't breathe.

title: The Ambergris Element
line: What happened to them, Doctor? What is it?

title: The Ambergris Element
line: Something's changed their whole lung structure. They can't live in the air anymore. Medical log, stardate 5506.2. Captain Kirk and First Office Spock were rescued forty eight hours ago. They have no recollection of what happened to them after they were attacked, but medical examinations show and unidentified substance in the bloodstream has affected their entire metabolism and changed them into water-breathers. Their internal structure is completely transformed, and even their eyes are covered with a transparent film like the second eyelid of a fish. So far all efforts to return them to normal have failed.

title: The Ambergris Element
line: We're stumped, Jim. The hormone seems to be the major factor in your mutation, but we just can't identify it.

title: The Ambergris Element
line: Are you sure the mutation wasn't somehow accomplished naturally?

title: The Ambergris Element
line: It was infused into your bodies at key structural points. It had to be done by injection.

title: The Ambergris Element
line: But can't you duplicate it, Bones? Your medical computers have information on every procedure in the Federation's hospitals.

title: The Ambergris Element
line: It's highly sophisticated and completely unknown to us.

title: The Ambergris Element
line: That implies there are intelligent life forms on Argo.

title: The Ambergris Element
line: The sensors don't indicate any life forms down there, aside from fish.

title: The Ambergris Element
line: They did fail to indicate the large marine creature that attacked us. Perhaps the readings are incomplete, blocked by underwater pressure forces. Oceans are less turbulent at greater depth. Such conditions would be more suitable to intelligent forms.

title: The Ambergris Element
line: Well, we can't do much underwater exploration without the aqua-shuttle. Our equipment is too limited.

title: The Ambergris Element
line: We aren't limited. We can go wherever we want in that ocean.

title: The Ambergris Element
line: It's too risky, Jim. Argo's almost totally unexplored. You'd be out of contact range, unarmed.

title: The Ambergris Element
line: I have to, Bones. Look at this place. A tank. I can't command a ship from inside an aquarium. I can't live in here.

title: The Ambergris Element
line: I know what you're saying, Jim, but if you go down on that planet and you die there

title: The Ambergris Element
line: Right now we have only two choices. Live in an aquarium somewhere for the rest of our lives or stay on Argo. I won't accept either one of them.

title: The Ambergris Element
line: What about you, Spock? What does your logic tell you?

title: The Ambergris Element
line: The Captain states the case emotionally, of course, but correctly. I would be of little value to this ship if I am confined to a tank in Sickbay. I must accompany the Captain.

title: The Ambergris Element
line: An intelligence that can produce this kind of mutation can change us back. We've got to find it, Bones. It must be there.

title: The Ambergris Element
line: We'll make contact as soon as possible, Mister Scott.

title: The Ambergris Element
line: Aye, sir.

title: The Ambergris Element
line: Go away, air breathers. You're not wanted here.

title: The Ambergris Element
line: We won't harm you. We're friends.

title: The Ambergris Element
line: Leave us. It is enough our young saved your lives once. If you go on, nothing will save you again.

title: The Ambergris Element
line: Wait. Listen.

title: The Ambergris Element
line: Go away.

title: The Ambergris Element
line: I don't understand. They said they'd saved us once.

title: The Ambergris Element
line: I believe the phrase was, 'our young saved your lives once.'

title: The Ambergris Element
line: Yes, and they didn't seem to approve. The answer appears to be in that direction, Spock.

title: The Ambergris Element
line: I would say so, Captain. The instinctive reaction of all frightened creatures is to retreat to a place of safety.

title: The Ambergris Element
line: Fascinating. And beautiful.

title: The Ambergris Element
line: An undersea civilisation capable of fantastic architecture. Medical triumphs unheard of in our galaxy. Why should they be afraid of us, Spock?

title: The Ambergris Element
line: It is quite possible, Captain, that they find us grotesque and ugly. And many people fear beings different from themselves.

title: The Ambergris Element
line: Well, speculation isn't much help. We have to get in there.

title: The Ambergris Element
line: Perhaps there is a way open on the far side. There is much less activity there.

title: The Ambergris Element
line: That building in the center. It seems to be important.

title: The Ambergris Element
line: You stand before the Ruling Tribunal of the Aquans. I am Domar, the High Tribune.

title: The Ambergris Element
line: I'm Captain Kirk of the starship Enterprise. This is my first officer, Mister Spock.

title: The Ambergris Element
line: You are air-breather enemies from the surface. We have expected spies for a long time.

title: The Ambergris Element
line: We came here in peace, Tribune.

title: The Ambergris Element
line: The ancient records warn that air-breathers never come in peace.

title: The Ambergris Element
line: They came without weapons.

title: The Ambergris Element
line: Can we do nothing without consulting the ancient records?

title: The Ambergris Element
line: Why do the Junior Tribunes wish always to change the records?

title: The Ambergris Element
line: Let the mesh be removed, but stand ready.

title: The Ambergris Element
line: The surgo-op was excellent. They have mutated perfectly.

title: The Ambergris Element
line: Your scientists induced these mutations?

title: The Ambergris Element
line: We do not wish to kill, even air-breathers. Your memory was eradicated so you could not return here.

title: The Ambergris Element
line: It would seem their ancient records are as well preserved as ours. They found us again to come among us as spies.

title: The Ambergris Element
line: You do not give them a chance to defend themselves, Cadmar.

title: The Ambergris Element
line: Rila is correct. You may speak.

title: The Ambergris Element
line: We are visitors to your planet. We come from another world.

title: The Ambergris Element
line: You do not live on the surface places?

title: The Ambergris Element
line: Not on this world.

title: The Ambergris Element
line: Enough! Clearly, this is a lie. The air-breathers have come again to destroy us.

title: The Ambergris Element
line: You are mistaken, sir. Our only purpose here is to find the means of reversing our mutations.

title: The Ambergris Element
line: That is impossible. Only Aquan mutation is designated by the surgo-records.

title: The Ambergris Element
line: Enterprise to Mister Scott.

title: The Ambergris Element
line: Scott here. What is it, Doctor?

title: The Ambergris Element
line: Sensors just gave us an update reading, Scotty. There's a seaquake due in that area, a bad one. Complete topography changes.

title: The Ambergris Element
line: How soon?

title: The Ambergris Element
line: Within four hours. When are Jim and Spock due to make contact?

title: The Ambergris Element
line: About the same time.

title: The Ambergris Element
line: Can you contact them sooner?

title: The Ambergris Element
line: We can try like blue blazes. Scott out.

title: The Ambergris Element
line: Their directional marker indicates they descended toward that fern bed.

title: The Ambergris Element
line: Air-breathers. We must inform the Tribunes.

title: The Ambergris Element
line: The name of our starship is on the aqua-shuttle. If you want proof, examine the wreckage.

title: The Ambergris Element
line: Yes. Let us examine the wreckage before we make judgment.

title: The Ambergris Element
line: We have news, High Tribune.

title: The Ambergris Element
line: Speak it.

title: The Ambergris Element
line: Three air-breathers have invaded the sea foliage. We saw them as we gathered edibles.

title: The Ambergris Element
line: Do you still believe these creatures came in peace?

title: The Ambergris Element
line: We do not know what to believe.

title: The Ambergris Element
line: Take these spies to the surface boulders and leave them there. It is justice enough for our enemies. {Rocks]

title: The Ambergris Element
line: Conserve your strength. I will free you. The mesh is too strong.

title: The Ambergris Element
line: Go to the big island. Bring assistance party.

title: The Ambergris Element
line: Did you see anything?

title: The Ambergris Element
line: Not a sign of them. Wait a minute. Who are

title: The Ambergris Element
line: Follow me. Your friends need help.

title: The Ambergris Element
line: There.

title: The Ambergris Element
line: Quick, lads.

title: The Ambergris Element
line: Stand by in the scouter-gig, Lieutenant.

title: The Ambergris Element
line: Rila, this is my engineering officer, Mister Scott. Tribune Rila is an Aquan. Their city is a short distance away.

title: The Ambergris Element
line: We're obliged for your help. Captain, we've been trying to contact you for two hours. There's a sea bottom quake due. It'll destroy this whole area.

title: The Ambergris Element
line: There are legends of such a happening. It destroyed the ancient knowledge and caused the great surface places to sink into the sea.

title: The Ambergris Element
line: That suggests your race evolved from its ancient enemies.

title: The Ambergris Element
line: We did not evolve, Mister Spock. When the surface places began to sink, many air-breathers were mutated through surgo-op, just as you were. As the centuries passed, the mutations became hereditary.

title: The Ambergris Element
line: Strange that such a highly developed race would be violent.

title: The Ambergris Element
line: Apparently they were exposed to a frightening geological disaster. Such hardship induces savagery and violence.

title: The Ambergris Element
line: They hunted and killed us. We feared they would contaminate us with their violence. That is also why it is forbidden to mutate back to surface forms.

title: The Ambergris Element
line: Then reverse mutation is possible.

title: The Ambergris Element
line: There are legends of sealed places in the sunken ruins where many knowledge records of it are kept.

title: The Ambergris Element
line: There's not much time, Captain. The quake's due in less than two hours.

title: The Ambergris Element
line: How far are the ruins, Rila?

title: The Ambergris Element
line: Only a short distance.

title: The Ambergris Element
line: Those old records may hold the key to reversing our mutations. We've got to find them before it's too late.

title: The Ambergris Element
line: I cannot take you to the ruins. It is against ordainments.

title: The Ambergris Element
line: It's important, Rila. Not just for us. The population of another planet is threatened by surface changes, too. Argo's ancient knowledge can help save them.

title: The Ambergris Element
line: Yes. I will take you as far as the reef barrier.

title: The Ambergris Element
line: The ruins lie that way. Now, take care. The tides are strong.

title: The Ambergris Element
line: Fascinating. Obviously, an entire portion of the continental shelf sank within a few minutes. This may be the sealed place Rila mentioned. I believe this is an entrance panel, Captain.

title: The Ambergris Element
line: There's another chamber.

title: The Ambergris Element
line: This resembles ancient medical symbols, Captain. The torso indicates mutation.

title: The Ambergris Element
line: That's it, Spock. The key to the survival of the race.

title: The Ambergris Element
line: If the universal translator is right, the substance in your bloodstream is similar to the ambergris of Earth whales. Reverse mutation is induced by infusion of an antitoxin, concentrated doses of it.

title: The Ambergris Element
line: What's the composition of the antitoxin, Bones?

title: The Ambergris Element
line: It's made from the venom of the Argo sur-snake.

title: The Ambergris Element
line: To capture a sur-snake, we need your help. Our people can't descend to that depth.

title: The Ambergris Element
line: Domar has warned that if we break more ordainments, we will be exiled to the open seas.

title: The Ambergris Element
line: We cannot reverse our mutations without the serum, nor can the Aquans benefit from the knowledge of their ancestors.

title: The Ambergris Element
line: But the ordainments state clearly that capturing sur-snakes is forbidden.

title: The Ambergris Element
line: Ordainments are useless in times of turbulence. Only knowledge will help us.

title: The Ambergris Element
line: Nephro, we must break the ordainments.

title: The Ambergris Element
line: Quickly, Captain.

title: The Ambergris Element
line: Quickly, we must leave.

title: The Ambergris Element
line: We need more venom.

title: The Ambergris Element
line: No, no, there is no time.

title: The Ambergris Element
line: We have prepared an antitoxin from the venom of the sur-snake, but a part of the old records is missing, so the exact dosage is unknown. Experiments on fish show that if the antitoxin is too strong, it causes over-mutation, which cannot be reversed by any means. We're running out of venom, so conclusive experiments are impossible. I decreased the strength by three quarters, Jim, but we can't be sure it's right.

title: The Ambergris Element
line: How many infusions, Bones?

title: The Ambergris Element
line: Two small, one large.

title: The Ambergris Element
line: Well, let's get started.

title: The Ambergris Element
line: His pulse is fading. Pulse and heart normal. Something's happening to his metabolism. It's at least ten times normal speed. Metabolism normal. Heartbeat normal. The lungs are beginning to revert. This is the last dose, the largest infusion. The antitoxin was too strong. He's starting to breathe. Quick, get him out of the tank!

title: The Ambergris Element
line: How do you feel, Jim?

title: The Ambergris Element
line: A little dizzy. Otherwise normal.

title: The Ambergris Element
line: Well, better get into some dry clothes. I wouldn't want you to catch cold. Your turn, Spock.

title: The Ambergris Element
line: We'll bombard the unpopulated pressure areas with phaser beams and change the epicenter of the quake so it won't endanger your people or your city.

title: The Ambergris Element
line: I did not believe such knowledge was possible.

title: The Ambergris Element
line: Major tremors will start in three minutes, Captain.

title: The Ambergris Element
line: It is incredible. All of it.

title: The Ambergris Element
line: Confirm co-ordinates, Mister Spock.

title: The Ambergris Element
line: Confirmed, sir.

title: The Ambergris Element
line: Fire phasers as directed, gentlemen.

title: The Ambergris Element
line: Aye, aye, sir.

title: The Ambergris Element
line: Sensors indicate the epicenter of the quake was in the north polar seas, Captain, a totally uninhabited area.

title: The Ambergris Element
line: Then our people are safe.

title: The Ambergris Element
line: When can we beam down, Spock?

title: The Ambergris Element
line: The seabed should stabilize within a few hours.

title: The Ambergris Element
line: Argo appears to have a new city, Captain, or rather, one reborn.

title: The Ambergris Element
line: Our people survived the seaquakes with little damage, thanks to your help.

title: The Ambergris Element
line: We owe you and your friends much gratitude, Captain Kirk. We will try to repay by making the ancient records available for your studies.

title: The Ambergris Element
line: Our experience here has shown us the means of diverting quakes. That will mean much to the endangered Federation planet.

title: The Ambergris Element
line: The light is warm and the air is soft. I shall be glad when the surface places can be inhabited.

title: The Ambergris Element
line: The young Aquans have decided to rebuild the great shelters of the air-breathers.

title: The Ambergris Element
line: Only the young Aquans?

title: The Ambergris Element
line: Senior Aquans cannot adjust to the thought of becoming air-breathers. We will remain at the Aqua City.

title: The Ambergris Element
line: Don't lose contact with each other like your ancestors.

title: The Ambergris Element
line: We will pass ordainments to forbid it.

title: The Ambergris Element
line: And we, this time, will not ignore them.

title: The Jihad
line: Captain's log, stardate 5683.1. We're making a rendezvous with the Vedala asteroid on a unique mission. The Vedala are the oldest space faring race we know. They say something incredibly dangerous to the safety of our galaxy is developing and they have sent for selected specialists, including Spock and myself.

title: The Jihad
line: Maintain the Enterprise in this position, Sulu. If Spock and I survive, we'll return here. If not, Mister Scott, you have your orders. Energize.

title: The Jihad
line: Welcome, Captain James Kirk and Commander Spock. I will introduce you. First, Tchar. Hereditary prince of the Skorr, master of the eerie. Sord.

title: The Jihad
line: I was sentenced to this mad expedition. My people are cautious, what you would call cowards.

title: The Jihad
line: As an expert lockpick and thief, you are welcome. Em3green. Lara is a hunter. She has a flawless directional sense, a necessary skill where you are going. Mister Spock was chosen for his analytical mind and scientific expertise. Captain Kirk for his leadership and adaptability. Tchar will explain your mission.

title: The Jihad
line: Two centuries past, my people, the Skorr, were great warriors. We had advanced military technology and we could breed vast armies rapidly. But today we are a civilized people because of Alar.

title: The Jihad
line: A religious leader, was he not?

title: The Jihad
line: Our salvation and our teacher. He brought us peace. He made us great. He died, and we made him immortal.

title: The Jihad
line: Alar's brain patterns were recorded before his death, in a piece of indurite sculpture.

title: The Jihad
line: Our Soul, the Soul of the Skorr, was stolen.

title: The Jihad
line: The theft triggered a racial fury in the Skorr. They are preparing for war.

title: The Jihad
line: Against whom?

title: The Jihad
line: The known galaxy.

title: The Jihad
line: It is a very real threat. In two standard years, the existing Skorr could breed an army of two hundred billion warriors.

title: The Jihad
line: My government fears this, so the theft of the Soul of Alar has been kept secret. But we must recover it before my people diskover it gone and go mad, launch a jihad, a holy war on the galaxy.

title: The Jihad
line: Who took the Soul?

title: The Jihad
line: Unknown. The motive, as Tchar has said, to provoke a holy war.

title: The Jihad
line: Is there any clue to its location?

title: The Jihad
line: A mad planet, Geologically unstable. Constant earthquakes, gravitic shifts, tidal waves. The temperature varies from twenty Kelvin to two hundred and four above. Somewhere on that planet, the Soul of Alar is hidden. Three expeditions have tried to recover it. Three expeditions have been lost. You are the next, if you agree.

title: The Jihad
line: The Vedala are a powerful race. Why haven't your people retrieved the Soul?

title: The Jihad
line: My people could not survive on that planet. You have a chance.

title: The Jihad
line: We agree.

title: The Jihad
line: Then it is done.

title: The Jihad
line: I cannot feel the Soul. We are nowhere near it.

title: The Jihad
line: That is to be expected. The surface of this planet shifts constantly. Even the Vedala are not certain where the Soul is.

title: The Jihad
line: It has directional equipment that keys on indurite.

title: The Jihad
line: I like this place, it's got variety.

title: The Jihad
line: I can handle the machine.

title: The Jihad
line: Our direction is indicated.

title: The Jihad
line: It's phasing, unfocusing.

title: The Jihad
line: Why did the Vedala call this the Mad planet?

title: The Jihad
line: Means nothing. I can tell the way. That way.

title: The Jihad
line: Are you certain, human?

title: The Jihad
line: For sure, birdman. I can't get lost. I can't be fooled about directions. That's why I'm here.

title: The Jihad
line: The Vedala would not have chosen Lara if her abilities were less than perfect.

title: The Jihad
line: Agreed, but we're forced to travel on the ground. I want an overview.

title: The Jihad
line: I will scout overhead.

title: The Jihad
line: The Vedala will have been efficient in equipping us. I will acquaint myself with our supplies.

title: The Jihad
line: Vulcans. Never liked them much myself. Cold-blooded critters, all of them.

title: The Jihad
line: I wouldn't say that. Mister Spock is a unique personality.

title: The Jihad
line: But not human like you and me. Maybe you got different customs. My world there's a lot of females, not so many men. Come we find a man attractive, we say so. I'm saying so. How do you find me?

title: The Jihad
line: Fascinating. But we're not here on a pleasure trip, Lara.

title: The Jihad
line: All the more reason to take what pleasure there might be in it.

title: The Jihad
line: I have checked the supplies, Captain. As expected, they are adequate and there are weapons.

title: The Jihad
line: Against what? There's no life on this planet.

title: The Jihad
line: But there is, Captain. Ourselves. And there may be other things guarding the Soul of Alar.

title: The Jihad
line: Real weather.

title: The Jihad
line: And a half.

title: The Jihad
line: We'll all die here.

title: The Jihad
line: A statistical probability.

title: The Jihad
line: You ever quote anything besides statistics, Vulcan?

title: The Jihad
line: Yes. But philosophy and poetry are not appropriate here.

title: The Jihad
line: I can see something. I can sense it, the Soul of Alar is there.

title: The Jihad
line: Something's coming.

title: The Jihad
line: A lava flow. Volcanic action is to be expected.

title: The Jihad
line: Never mind that. You got to get us out of here.

title: The Jihad
line: We might be able to divert the lava flow with a barricade. Tchar, get us a visual estimate!

title: The Jihad
line: Such a diversion would be of short duration, Captain. And I must point out, the vehicle lacks sufficient speed to escape.

title: The Jihad
line: Not if we used all of the power pack's energy for one high speed run.

title: The Jihad
line: It is possible, but the rewiring of the power leads is complex and time-consuming.

title: The Jihad
line: I could do it, if you can diagram the schematics, sir.

title: The Jihad
line: Yes, quickly then. Terminal M3 red, lead to diode shunt A37. Cross connect to A14.

title: The Jihad
line: Kirk. There is a ravine sixty meters to your left. If it can be blocked, the lava will flow past those rocks to one side.

title: The Jihad
line: Got it. Sord.

title: The Jihad
line: I heard him.

title: The Jihad
line: Carefully, Em. One missed connection could destroy us.

title: The Jihad
line: I know. I'm trying to be careful. (Kirk, Sord and Lara push boulders off the cliff and create a rock fall to block the ravine.

title: The Jihad
line: I figure we've bought ourselves a little time. Few minutes.

title: The Jihad
line: It's re-rigged. Hurry.

title: The Jihad
line: Come on, insect, move it.

title: The Jihad
line: Twenty one degrees east. Fifty meters to get out of the flow path.

title: The Jihad
line: Hurry.

title: The Jihad
line: Go.

title: The Jihad
line: Leave, all of you.

title: The Jihad
line: Not without you.

title: The Jihad
line: Captain, you must get the others away.

title: The Jihad
line: We're all getting away.

title: The Jihad
line: Close.

title: The Jihad
line: Far too close, Captain. I appreciate your action on my behalf, but your first duty is to the group and the mission.

title: The Jihad
line: Quite right, Spock. And that responsibility includes not losing the best science officer in Starfleet.

title: The Jihad
line: You two going to argue honors, or are we going to get on with it?

title: The Jihad
line: Oh! And I was just going to ask, what next?

title: The Jihad
line: We move on.

title: The Jihad
line: The power pack is burned out.

title: The Jihad
line: We'll have to carry the equipment.

title: The Jihad
line: Anything?

title: The Jihad
line: Wait. Yes, yes!

title: The Jihad
line: I can't go any farther. I'm not even afraid anymore. Just very tired.

title: The Jihad
line: Come on, Em, a bit more.

title: The Jihad
line: No. I'm finished.

title: The Jihad
line: Sorry, Em. We'll be needing you. Sord.

title: The Jihad
line: Let me go.

title: The Jihad
line: Hang on.

title: The Jihad
line: I'll go ahead.

title: The Jihad
line: What is it?

title: The Jihad
line: Not sure. Thought I saw something move in the brush.

title: The Jihad
line: There is no life on this planet.

title: The Jihad
line: Guess you're right. This planet just gets on your nerves.

title: The Jihad
line: I can sense the Soul. I will fly ahead, examine the building, and meet you on the way.

title: The Jihad
line: Tchar, be careful. We need you, too.

title: The Jihad
line: We're tired, sore, hurt and angry, but we're also just about there. I'll scout ahead. Everybody else stay together, keep moving.

title: The Jihad
line: I'll go with you. Remember, scouting's my job. By rights, I should be doing it alone.

title: The Jihad
line: Sord, what did you think you saw back there?

title: The Jihad
line: Don't know, Vulcan. A shape, couldn't really make it out. Probably seeing things, like Kirk figures.

title: The Jihad
line: There should be no life on this planet.

title: The Jihad
line: You keep saying that.

title: The Jihad
line: Yes. The Vedala would have informed us if there were any live beings here we should know of.

title: The Jihad
line: Maybe the Vedala didn't know about it.

title: The Jihad
line: That is an impossibility.

title: The Jihad
line: Think so? I'm not so sure.

title: The Jihad
line: That's it. End of a long, hard journey.

title: The Jihad
line: We still have to go back, James. I tell you true, I find you an attractive man. If we were together, the trip would be easier. And if anything happened, why, we'd have some green memories.

title: The Jihad
line: I already have a lot of green memories.

title: The Jihad
line: Oh.

title: The Jihad
line: Maybe some other time, Lara. We still have our work cut out for us here.

title: The Jihad
line: Is this not the shape of your people's primitive temples?

title: The Jihad
line: Yes. The entrance should be . Can you open it?

title: The Jihad
line: There is no lock I can't pick.

title: The Jihad
line: What is it?

title: The Jihad
line: I'm opening the locks.

title: The Jihad
line: Wonderful.

title: The Jihad
line: No. They're on a timed trigger. If I don't get all the locks open quickly enough, it explodes.

title: The Jihad
line: Keep working. I'll cover you.

title: The Jihad
line: They're mechanical.

title: The Jihad
line: The Vedala were right. There are no living creatures here, only the mechanized sentinels.

title: The Jihad
line: Hurry, small one.

title: The Jihad
line: We'll hit Tchar.

title: The Jihad
line: What happened to Tchar?

title: The Jihad

line: I'm not built for that sort of thing. I'll wait for you down here.

title: The Jihad
line: Most of them will be killed. The warrior races of the Federation will rise up to battle the Skorr.

title: The Jihad
line: Yes. A noble death to win a great dream. We will live no longer like worms crawling in the dirt. We will conquer. You will die. But you have my respect. You fought well. You die in grace.

title: The Terratin Incident

title: The Terratin Incident
line: Put it on the speaker.

line: Could be a natural radio source newly energized by

title: The Terratin Incident

title: The Terratin Incident
line: Yes, sir.

title: The Terratin Incident
line: It's a waste of time if you ask me.

line: Only data is from early exploration. Planet is listed as Class M, core molten, mantle and crust entirely crystalline.

title: The Terratin Incident

line: Set for a single elliptic orbit.

title: The Terratin Incident
line: Aye, sir. Entering orbit now.

title: The Terratin Incident
line: I register a disturbance, Captain. As if an impulse just passed through the ship.

title: The Terratin Incident

line: Unidentified. It's extremely faint and diffused. Captain, I suggest we delay orbit until it can be analyzed for nature and effect.

title: The Terratin Incident

title: The Terratin Incident

line: Bridge to Engineering. Scotty, how are your engines?

title: The Terratin Incident
line: Purring like happy kittens, Captain.

title: The Terratin Incident
line: Bridge to Sickbay. Bones, we've just recorded an unidentified impulse. Any effect on sensitive lab animals?

title: The Terratin Incident
line: Nothing, Jim. The gossamer mice show no signs of shock.

title: The Terratin Incident
line: Our halo fish is bright as ever, Doctor. Now, this species loses all color at the least environmental change.

title: The Terratin Incident
line: Very well.

title: The Terratin Incident
line: Well, Spock, your x-waves seem harmless enough. Make your analysis while we proceed into orbit. Commence your sensor sweep, Mister Arex.

line: Sensors show crystalline surface heavily fractured by lava flows. Ash and smoke suspended in oxygen-nitrogen atmos

line: My eyes!

line: Anyone hurt here?

title: The Terratin Incident
line: No, sir.

line: Lieutenant Arex?

title: The Terratin Incident
line: No injury, sir.

title: The Terratin Incident
line: Damage reports, all ship areas, damage reports.

title: The Terratin Incident
line: All instruments functioning normally. Maintaining orbit. But strictly on impulse power, sir.

title: The Terratin Incident
line: Wave bombardment reduced, but continuing. Deflector shields ineffective.

title: The Terratin Incident
line: No casualties reported, Jim.

line: Engineering. No casualties, Captain, but trouble aplenty with the engines. Every dilithium crystal connection's smashed in the warp engine circuitry. We're trying to bypass them now.
